terms.definition_short: AI 简史时间线：从 1943 年到 2024 年的 AI 里程碑事件——感知机、专家系统、深度学习、LLM。
terms.definition_short_en: A chronological overview of artificial intelligence milestones from 1943 to 2024, tracing the evolution from early perceptrons and expert systems to modern deep learning and large language models.

terms.definition_short: AICore：Apple Intelligence 的本地模型推理引擎——iOS 18 在设备上跑 LLM 不连云端。
terms.definition_short_en: AICore is the local model inference engine for Apple Intelligence, enabling iOS 18 to run large language models directly on-device without relying on the cloud.

terms.definition_short: 李飞飞提出的 AI 应用概念——用传感器在医院和家庭中被动监测健康安全，不引人注意，只在危险时告警。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI application concept proposed by Fei-Fei Li that uses sensors to passively monitor health and safety in hospitals and homes, remaining unobtrusive and only alerting when danger occurs.

terms.definition_short: AI API 设计：设计大模型 API 的最佳实践——速率限制、错误处理、重试、流式输出、语义缓存。
terms.definition_short_en: AI API design encompasses the best practices for integrating large language model APIs, focusing on rate limiting, error handling, retry mechanisms, streaming outputs, and semantic caching.

terms.definition_short: API 性能优化：LLM API 调用的延迟和成本优化——缓存、批处理、流式、fallback 模型。
terms.definition_short_en: The process of reducing latency and costs for LLM API calls through techniques such as caching, batching, streaming, and fallback models.

terms.definition_short: 自动驾驶：让汽车在不需要人持续干预的情况下感知环境、规划路径并控制车辆。
terms.definition_short_en: Autonomous driving enables vehicles to perceive their environment, plan routes, and control the car without continuous human intervention.

terms.definition_short: Backward Compatibility 是新版本能继续支持旧版本的数据、接口或行为，让升级不破坏现有用户。
terms.definition_short_en: Backward compatibility is when a new version continues to support the data, interfaces, or behaviors of older versions, ensuring that upgrades do not disrupt existing users.

terms.definition_short: Blender：开源的 3D 创作软件，支持建模、动画、渲染、模拟和合成，AI 插件让它能生成 3D 资产。
terms.definition_short_en: An open-source 3D creation suite supporting modeling, animation, rendering, simulation, and compositing, which can now generate 3D assets through AI plugins.

terms.definition_short: Bloom Filter 是一种空间效率很高的概率型数据结构，用多个哈希函数判断元素是否在集合里。
terms.definition_short_en: A Bloom filter is a highly space-efficient probabilistic data structure that uses multiple hash functions to test whether an element is a member of a set.

terms.definition_short: Cerebras：做晶圆级芯片（Wafer-Scale Engine）的 AI 芯片公司，用一整块晶圆做成一颗超大芯片。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI chip company known for its Wafer-Scale Engine (WSE), which turns an entire silicon wafer into a single massive chip instead of dicing it into smaller processors.

terms.definition_short: Chatbot 是聊天机器人，用对话形式回答问题、执行任务或陪伴用户。
terms.definition_short_en: A chatbot is an AI program that answers questions, performs tasks, or provides companionship through conversational interactions.

terms.definition_short: ChatGPT 发展史：从 2022 年 11 月 GPT-3.5 起步到 2024 年 GPT-4o 实时多模态——两年的急速进化。
terms.definition_short_en: The history of ChatGPT: A rapid two-year evolution from its launch with GPT-3.5 in November 2022 to the real-time multimodal capabilities of GPT-4o in 2024.

terms.definition_short: Civitai：AI 模型分享社区——十几万个 Stable Diffusion 模型和 LoRA 在上面被下载分享。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI model-sharing community where hundreds of thousands of Stable Diffusion models and LoRAs are uploaded, downloaded, and shared by creators.

terms.definition_short: ClipDrop：Stability AI 的图片增强工具——AI 一键去背景、升分辨率、打光重光照、文生图。
terms.definition_short_en: ClipDrop is an AI-powered image enhancement toolkit by Stability AI that offers one-click background removal, image upscaling, relighting, and text-to-image generation.

terms.definition_short: ComfyUI：Stable Diffusion 的节点式工作流编辑器——把生成流程拆成节点连成图，灵活可控。
terms.definition_short_en: A node-based workflow editor for Stable Diffusion that breaks the generation process into distinct nodes connected in a graph, providing highly flexible and controllable outputs.

terms.definition_short: ControlNet：让 Stable Diffusion 按条件图（线稿、深度、姿态）生成的控制技术。
terms.definition_short_en: A neural network architecture that adds spatial conditioning controls—such as line art, depth maps, and human poses—to Stable Diffusion models.

terms.definition_short: Conversational AI：以自然语言对话为核心交互方式的 AI 系统——涵盖聊天机器人、语音助手、客服、车载等场景。
terms.definition_short_en: Conversational AI is an AI system centered on natural language dialogue as its primary interaction method, covering applications like chatbots, voice assistants, customer service, and in-car systems.

terms.definition_short: CoreML：Apple 的机器学习框架，让开发者把模型部署到 Apple 设备上，利用 Neural Engine 加速。
terms.definition_short_en: Apple's machine learning framework that enables developers to deploy models across Apple devices, utilizing the Neural Engine for hardware-accelerated inference.

terms.definition_short: DuckDuckGo AI：注重隐私的搜索引擎在 2024 年加入了 AI 聊天和 AI 摘要功能。
terms.definition_short_en: DuckDuckGo AI represents the privacy-focused search engine's integration of AI chat and summarization features, allowing users to leverage advanced language models without compromising their personal data.

terms.definition_short: DeepSpeed：微软开源的深度学习训练优化库——用 ZeRO 优化把万亿参数模型拆到几千个 GPU 上训——各卡存一部分——卡间通信。
terms.definition_short_en: DeepSpeed is an open-source deep learning optimization library by Microsoft that uses ZeRO to partition trillion-parameter models across thousands of GPUs, storing only a fraction on each card and relying on inter-GPU communication.

terms.definition_short: Descript：AI 视频音频编辑器——像编辑文字一样编辑视频音频。删除文字就可以删掉对应音频片段。
terms.definition_short_en: Descript is an AI-powered audio and video editor that lets you edit media by editing text. Deleting a word in the transcript automatically removes the corresponding audio or video segment.

terms.definition_short: Dragon NaturallySpeaking：Nuance 开发的连续语音识别软件，把说话转成文字，用于文档、邮件、控制电脑。
terms.definition_short_en: A continuous speech recognition software developed by Nuance that converts spoken words into text, widely used for dictating documents, writing emails, and controlling computers.

terms.definition_short: Edge AI：把 AI 模型部署到本地设备上运行，不依赖云端，低延迟、保护隐私。
terms.definition_short_en: Edge AI refers to deploying AI models to run locally on devices, operating independently of the cloud to deliver low latency and protect user privacy.

terms.definition_short: ElasticSearch：分布式搜索引擎，支持全文检索、结构化搜索和向量搜索，在 AI 场景里常用于 RAG 知识库。
terms.definition_short_en: ElasticSearch is a distributed search engine that supports full-text, structured, and vector search, frequently used as a knowledge base backend in RAG applications.

terms.definition_short: ELIZA：1966 年 MIT Joseph Weizenbaum 开发的最早聊天机器人，用关键字匹配和模板回复模拟对话。
terms.definition_short_en: Developed by Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT in 1966, ELIZA was the first chatbot, using simple keyword matching and template responses to simulate human conversation.

terms.definition_short: Emergent Abilities：大模型规模到一定程度后突然出现的能力，小模型没有，大模型突然有了。
terms.definition_short_en: Emergent abilities refer to capabilities that suddenly appear when a large language model reaches a certain scale—absent in smaller models but abruptly present in larger ones.

terms.definition_short: Face ID：Apple 的面部识别系统，用原深感摄像头投射红外点构建面部 3D 模型，用于解锁和支付。
terms.definition_short_en: Apple's facial recognition system that uses a TrueDepth camera to project infrared dots and build a 3D facial map for secure device unlocking and payments.

terms.definition_short: Fake News Detection：用 AI 自动判断新闻真假，交叉验证多源信息、检测文本风格异常、追溯信息源头。
terms.definition_short_en: Fake News Detection uses AI to automatically determine the authenticity of news by cross-verifying multiple sources, detecting text style anomalies, and tracing information origins.

terms.definition_short: Fast R-CNN：2015 年的目标检测模型，把候选区域和分类合并成一步，比 R-CNN 快 9 倍。
terms.definition_short_en: A 2015 object detection model that merges region proposals and classification into a single step, achieving speeds 9 times faster than the original R-CNN.

terms.definition_short: Few-Shot Learning：让模型用很少的样本学会新任务，通常几个到几十个例子就能做分类或生成。
terms.definition_short_en: Few-shot learning is a machine learning approach that enables models to learn new tasks—such as classification or generation—using only a handful to a few dozen examples.

terms.definition_short: 早停：训练时验证 loss 不再降了就提前停止——防止过拟合。最老最有效的正则化手段。
terms.definition_short_en: Early stopping halts model training when validation loss stops decreasing to prevent overfitting. It is one of the oldest and most effective regularization techniques.

terms.definition_short: FastAPI：Python 的现代 Web 框架——用类型提示做自动验证和文档生成，ML 模型部署 API 的首选。
terms.definition_short_en: A modern Python web framework that uses type hints for automatic data validation and documentation generation, making it the top choice for deploying machine learning models as APIs.

terms.definition_short: Framer：AI 网页设计工具——输入一句话 AI 自动生成整个网站设计交互原型。2024 年加入 AI 文生网站。
terms.definition_short_en: Framer is an AI-powered web design tool that generates complete, interactive website prototypes from a single text prompt. It introduced its text-to-website generation capabilities in 2024.

terms.definition_short: Frozen：迪士尼 2013 年的现象级动画——Let It Go 全球播放次数破百亿次——AI 时代前最后一代纯人类手工制作的 3D 动画。
terms.definition_short_en: Frozen is Disney's phenomenal 2013 animated film, featuring the hit song "Let It Go" with tens of billions of global plays, representing the last generation of purely human-crafted 3D animation before the AI era.

terms.definition_short: GDX：Google DeepMind 2024 年发布的 Google 最新大模型——注重长上下文和推理——用在多模态理解和代码上赶超 GPT-4。
terms.definition_short_en: GDX is a large language model released by Google DeepMind in 2024, focusing on long-context reasoning and designed to surpass GPT-4 in multimodal understanding and coding tasks.

terms.definition_short: Gemini API：Google DeepMind 的大模型 API——Gemini 1.5 Pro 原生多模态和 1M 长上下文。
terms.definition_short_en: Google DeepMind's foundation model API, highlighted by Gemini 1.5 Pro's native multimodality and massive 1M-token context window.

terms.definition_short: Gemini vs GPT-4：Google 和 OpenAI 的旗舰大模型对比——多模态、长上下文、推理能力的全面竞争。
terms.definition_short_en: A comparison between the flagship foundation models of Google and OpenAI, representing a comprehensive competition across multimodality, context windows, and reasoning capabilities.

terms.definition_short: GLM-4V：智谱 AI 2024 年发布的多模态大模型，能理解图片、图表、文档和视频，在中文场景上和 GPT-4V 竞争。
terms.definition_short_en: A multimodal foundation model released by Zhipu AI in 2024 that understands images, charts, documents, and videos, positioning itself as a competitor to GPT-4V in Chinese-language contexts.

terms.definition_short: GPT-4o：OpenAI 2024 年 5 月发布的实时多模态模型，能看图、说话、听音频，延迟低到像真人对话。
terms.definition_short_en: Released by OpenAI in May 2024, GPT-4o is a real-time multimodal model capable of processing images, speech, and audio with human-like conversational latency.

terms.definition_short: Gradient Boosting：把多个弱模型串起来，每个新模型纠正前一个的残差，最后加起来变成强模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Gradient Boosting is an ensemble technique that chains multiple weak models together, where each new model corrects the residual errors of the previous one to create a single strong model.

terms.definition_short: GPT-5：OpenAI 的下一代旗舰模型——预计 2025 年发布。继 GPT-4 的多模态全能后 GPT-5 可能具备 Agent 能力。
terms.definition_short_en: OpenAI's next-generation flagship model, expected to be released in 2025. Following GPT-4's multimodal capabilities, GPT-5 may feature advanced agentic abilities.

terms.definition_short: Gradio vs Streamlit：两个 Python 数据 App 框架，Gradio 专为模型 demo 设计，Streamlit 更通用做复杂仪表盘。
terms.definition_short_en: Gradio and Streamlit are two Python frameworks for building data apps: Gradio is purpose-built for rapid machine learning model demos, while Streamlit is a more general-purpose tool for complex dashboards.

terms.definition_short: Graphext：无代码数据分析平台——你上传表格数据——AI 自动做聚类、相关性图谱和段分割——不用写代码——可视化所有变量间的关系。
terms.definition_short_en: A no-code data analysis platform where you upload tabular data, and AI automatically performs clustering, correlation mapping, and segmentation to visualize relationships across all variables without requiring any coding.

terms.definition_short: Gretel：合成数据平台——用深度学习生成和原数据统计特性相同的假数据——保护隐私又能供 AI 使用——用于医疗金融等隐私敏感的场景。
terms.definition_short_en: Gretel is a synthetic data platform that uses deep learning to generate artificial data with the same statistical properties as the original, enabling privacy-safe AI training in sensitive sectors like healthcare and finance.

terms.definition_short: HuggingFace Hub：HF 的模型和数据共享平台——不只是下载模型，是上传、版本管理、文档、演示一站式。
terms.definition_short_en: HuggingFace Hub is a model and data sharing platform that goes beyond simple downloads, offering an all-in-one hub for uploading, version control, documentation, and interactive demos.

terms.definition_short: 工业机器人：固定程序的机械臂，在流水线上做焊接、喷涂、组装等工序。AI 让它从盲干变成看见再做。
terms.definition_short_en: Industrial robots are traditionally fixed-program mechanical arms used for welding, painting, and assembly on production lines. AI transforms them from blind executors into machines that perceive their environment before acting.

terms.definition_short: Information Theory 把「信息」变成可计算、可压缩、可传输、可抗噪声的对象。
terms.definition_short_en: Information theory transforms information into a quantifiable entity that can be computed, compressed, transmitted, and made resilient to noise.

terms.definition_short: InternVL：上海 AI 实验室 2023 年的多模态大模型——开源的中文优势 VLM——看图问答在多项中文基准上第一。
terms.definition_short_en: InternVL is an open-source multimodal large language model released by the Shanghai AI Laboratory in 2023, known for its strong Chinese visual-language capabilities and top performance on multiple Chinese visual question-answering benchmarks.

terms.definition_short: JAX：Google 的 AI 计算框架——不是像 PyTorch 的图层——而是像 NumPy 一样的数组库——自带自动微分——JIT 编译到 XLA。
terms.definition_short_en: JAX is Google's AI computing framework. Rather than offering neural network layers like PyTorch, it acts as a NumPy-like array library with built-in automatic differentiation and JIT compilation to XLA.

terms.definition_short: JSON Schema：描述 JSON 数据结构的规范，定义字段名、类型、必填项、取值范围，让 AI 和程序自动校验 JSON 数据。
terms.definition_short_en: JSON Schema is a specification that describes the structure of JSON data by defining field names, data types, required fields, and value ranges, enabling AI and programs to automatically validate JSON payloads.

terms.definition_short: Knowledge Graph：把实体和关系建成图结构，让 AI 按实体关系推理，不只是按文本相似度检索。
terms.definition_short_en: A Knowledge Graph structures entities and their relationships into a graph, enabling AI to reason through entity connections rather than relying solely on text similarity retrieval.

terms.definition_short: Jina AI：德国柏林的开源 AI 公司——做神经网络搜索和多模态嵌入——Jina 用于跨模态检索——图搜文文搜图。
terms.definition_short_en: Jina AI is an open-source AI company based in Berlin, Germany, specializing in neural search and multimodal embeddings. Its framework enables cross-modal retrieval, such as searching text with images or vice versa.

terms.definition_short: Kaggle：2010 年创立的 AI 竞赛和数据科学社区——几十万数据科学家在上面比赛、学习、共享数据集和代码。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2010, Kaggle is an AI competition platform and data science community where hundreds of thousands of practitioners compete, learn, and share datasets and code.

terms.definition_short: KISMET 是 1990s 末 MIT 做的社交机器人，会通过表情和声音跟人互动。
terms.definition_short_en: KISMET is a social robot developed at MIT in the late 1990s that interacts with humans using facial expressions and vocalizations.

terms.definition_short: LangFuse：LLM 应用的开源可观测平台——追踪每次 LLM 调用的延迟、成本、质量和用户反馈。跟 LangSmith 同类开源替代。
terms.definition_short_en: LangFuse is an open-source observability platform for LLM applications that tracks the latency, cost, quality, and user feedback of every LLM call, serving as a self-hosted alternative to LangSmith.

terms.definition_short: Lepton AI：2023 年硅谷华人团队做的 AI 模型部署平台——一行命令把模型从 HuggingFace 变成云端 API。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in Silicon Valley in 2023, Lepton AI is a model deployment platform that turns any Hugging Face model into a scalable cloud API with a single command.

terms.definition_short: llama.cpp：用纯 C++ 写的 LLM 推理引擎——在 CPU 上跑 Llama 系列模型，苹果 M 系列的本地 LLM 标配。
terms.definition_short_en: llama.cpp is a pure C++ LLM inference engine that runs Llama-family models on CPUs, serving as the standard for local LLM deployment on Apple M-series chips.

terms.definition_short: Loom：2024 年被 Atlassian 收购的视频消息工具——AI 自动生成视频标题摘要章节。
terms.definition_short_en: A video messaging tool acquired by Atlassian in 2024 that uses AI to automatically generate titles, summaries, and chapters for recorded screen presentations.

terms.definition_short: LLaVA：2023 年开源的多模态大模型，把视觉编码器接到 LLaMA 上，让开源模型能看图说话。
terms.definition_short_en: An open-source multimodal large language model released in 2023 that connects a vision encoder to LLaMA, enabling open-source models to understand and describe images.

terms.definition_short: LM Studio：本地跑大模型的图形界面工具——下载 GGUF 模型，打开即用，完全本地运行。
terms.definition_short_en: LM Studio is a graphical user interface for running large language models locally; users simply download GGUF models and start chatting in a completely offline environment.

terms.definition_short: LoRA：Low-Rank Adaptation——冻结原模型参数，只在旁边加一个低秩矩阵训练，让 fine-tune 大模型的成本降几个数量级。
terms.definition_short_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) freezes the original model parameters and trains only a small, low-rank matrix added alongside them, reducing the cost of fine-tuning foundation models by several orders of magnitude.

terms.definition_short: LLaMA：Meta 2023 年开源的大语言模型系列——让开源 LLM 从玩具变成可用工具。
terms.definition_short_en: A series of large language models open-sourced by Meta in 2023 that transformed open-source LLMs from mere toys into highly usable tools.

terms.definition_short: LLM OS：把大模型作为操作系统的核心，管理硬件资源、调度模型推理、提供 AI 能力 API。
terms.definition_short_en: An LLM OS is a conceptual operating system that uses a large language model as its core to manage hardware resources, schedule model inference, and provide AI capability APIs.

terms.definition_short: Lovable 是自然语言生成应用的 AI 产品，帮助用户从需求描述快速得到网页、小应用或原型代码。
terms.definition_short_en: Lovable is an AI product for natural language app generation, helping users quickly turn requirement descriptions into web pages, small applications, or prototype code.

terms.definition_short: Manus：中国团队 2025 年发布的通用 AI Agent——能自主浏览网页、操作软件、写代码并执行多步任务——不是聊天机器人。
terms.definition_short_en: Released by the Chinese team Monica in 2025, Manus is a general-purpose AI agent—not a chatbot—that can autonomously browse the web, operate software, write code, and execute multi-step tasks.

terms.definition_short: Mathematica：Wolfram Research 的符号计算系统——不是数值算数学是符号上推公式。
terms.definition_short_en: A symbolic computation system developed by Wolfram Research that derives mathematical formulas algebraically rather than just calculating numerical approximations.

terms.definition_short: McCulloch-Pitts Neuron 是 1943 年提出的人工神经元模型，把神经活动和逻辑计算连到一起。
terms.definition_short_en: The McCulloch-Pitts Neuron is an artificial neuron model proposed in 1943 that first linked biological neural activity with logical computation.

terms.definition_short: 模型服务：把训好的模型上线成 API——用户发请求、模型跑推理、返回结果。MLflow 和 BentoML 是工具代表。
terms.definition_short_en: Model serving is the process of deploying a trained model as an API—users send requests, the model runs inference, and returns results. MLflow and BentoML are representative tools.

terms.definition_short: 莫拉维克悖论：AI 最容易做到的是人类觉得难的事——下棋、解数学题、写代码。最难做到的是人类觉得简单的事——走路、抓杯子、认人脸。
terms.definition_short_en: Moravec's paradox states that AI easily masters tasks humans find difficult, like playing chess, solving math problems, or writing code, but struggles immensely with things humans find effortless, like walking, grasping a cup, or recognizing faces.

terms.definition_short: NotebookLM 是 Google 的资料型 AI 研究与笔记工具，先围绕你提供的资料工作，再帮你问答、总结、引用和生成学习内容。
terms.definition_short_en: NotebookLM is Google's source-grounded AI research and note-taking tool that works exclusively with the materials you provide to answer questions, summarize content, provide citations, and generate study materials.

terms.definition_short: Notion AI：Notion 内置的 AI 助手，在笔记里直接写、改、总结、翻译、提取关键信息。
terms.definition_short_en: A built-in AI assistant for Notion that allows users to write, edit, summarize, translate, and extract key information directly within their notes.

terms.definition_short: NLLB：Meta 2022 年开源的翻译模型，支持 200 多种语言互译，包括很多小语种。
terms.definition_short_en: NLLB is an open-source translation model released by Meta in 2022 that supports translation between over 200 languages, with a focus on low-resource languages.

terms.definition_short: Nous Research：美国 AI 研究组织，专注开源大模型和函数调用、agent 能力增强，Hermes 系列是代表作品。
terms.definition_short_en: Nous Research is a US-based AI research organization dedicated to improving open-source foundation models, with a strong focus on enhancing function calling and agent capabilities, best known for its Hermes series.

terms.definition_short: Nous Hermes：Nous Research 的 fine-tune 模型系列，基于 Llama，增强函数调用和指令遵循，开源 Agent 框架常用底层模型。
terms.definition_short_en: A series of fine-tuned models by Nous Research based on Llama, designed to enhance function calling and instruction following for use as a foundational model in open-source AI agent frameworks.

terms.definition_short: NVIDIA NIM：NVIDIA 的模型推理微服务，把大模型打包成容器，一行 docker run 在 NVIDIA GPU 上跑。
terms.definition_short_en: NVIDIA NIM is a model inference microservice that packages foundation models into containers, enabling deployment on NVIDIA GPUs with a single `docker run` command.

terms.definition_short: Notion AI：Notion 内嵌的 AI 写作助手——在笔记里按一下 AI 按钮自动生成内容、总结、翻译、改写。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI writing assistant embedded directly within Notion that allows users to automatically generate, summarize, translate, and rewrite content with a single click inside their notes.

terms.definition_short: 神经网络处理器：专门为 AI 计算设计的芯片，在手机和边缘设备上本地跑模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Neural Processing Unit (NPU): A specialized chip designed specifically for AI computation, enabling models to run locally on smartphones and edge devices.

terms.definition_short: Ollama：一键在本地跑 Llama、Mistral、Gemma 等开源 LLM——把量化、API、管理全打包了。
terms.definition_short_en: Ollama is a tool that lets you run open-weight LLMs like Llama, Mistral, and Gemma locally with one click, packaging quantization, APIs, and model management into a single streamlined experience.

terms.definition_short: Open Interpreter：让 LLM 在你的电脑上执行代码——读文件、写脚本、操作本地数据。
terms.definition_short_en: An open-source tool that allows LLMs to execute code directly on your computer, enabling them to read files, write scripts, and manipulate local data.

terms.definition_short: Perplexity：AI 原生搜索引擎——不是把搜索结果链接返回而是用 LLM 直接在搜索结果的基础上生成带引用来源的回答。2022 年创立。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2022, Perplexity is an AI-native search engine that uses large language models to generate comprehensive answers with cited sources based on search results, rather than just returning a list of links.

terms.definition_short: Personal AI 是围绕一个人的资料、偏好、任务和长期目标工作的 AI 助手。
terms.definition_short_en: Personal AI is an AI assistant designed to operate around an individual's personal data, preferences, tasks, and long-term goals.

terms.definition_short: Physical AI 是让 AI 在真实物理世界里感知、规划、行动并根据结果修正的系统路线。
terms.definition_short_en: Physical AI is a system approach that enables AI to perceive, plan, act, and correct itself based on outcomes in the real physical world.

terms.definition_short: PID 控制器：经典控制算法，根据当前误差、累计误差、误差变化率三个量计算控制量，让系统稳定到目标值。
terms.definition_short_en: A classic control algorithm that calculates a control output based on current error, accumulated error, and the rate of error change to stabilize a system at a target value.

terms.definition_short: Pika：AI 视频生成工具，输入文字描述或图片生成短视频，常用于创意视频和广告原型。
terms.definition_short_en: Pika is an AI video generation tool that creates short videos from text descriptions or uploaded images, frequently used for creative content and advertising prototypes.

terms.definition_short: Pinecone：托管型向量数据库，专门存和检索向量，在 RAG 场景里常用作知识库后端。
terms.definition_short_en: Pinecone is a fully managed vector database designed for storing and retrieving vectors, frequently serving as the knowledge base backend in RAG applications.

terms.definition_short: Pika 2.0：Pika Labs 2024 年发布的视频生成模型升级版，提升视频质量、长度和控制能力。
terms.definition_short_en: An upgraded video generation model released by Pika Labs in 2024 that offers improved video quality, longer generation times, and enhanced creative control.

terms.definition_short: Platform Engineering：为开发团队搭建内部平台，把部署、监控、配置变成自助服务，让开发者专注写代码。
terms.definition_short_en: Platform Engineering is the practice of building internal platforms that turn deployment, monitoring, and configuration into self-service capabilities, allowing developers to focus entirely on writing code.

terms.definition_short: AI 播客：NotebookLM 的 Audio Overview——把你上传的文档自动变成两个人的播客对话。Google 2024 年发布。
terms.definition_short_en: Popularized by Google's NotebookLM Audio Overview in 2024, AI podcasts automatically transform uploaded documents into a conversational dialogue between two AI hosts.

terms.definition_short: Preference 是用户偏好，让 AI 知道你希望事情怎样被完成。
terms.definition_short_en: A preference is a user's specific choice or inclination that tells the AI exactly how they want tasks to be completed.

terms.definition_short: Project DIGITS 是 NVIDIA 面向开发者和小团队的桌面级 AI 超级计算机项目，把强 AI 算力放到本地工作台。
terms.definition_short_en: Project DIGITS is NVIDIA's desktop-class AI supercomputer project for developers and small teams, bringing powerful AI computing capabilities directly to local workstations.

terms.definition_short: 机器人规划：让机器人在物理世界把任务拆成可执行的动作序列。
terms.definition_short_en: Robot planning is the process of enabling a robot to break down high-level tasks into a sequence of executable physical actions within the real world.

terms.definition_short: Robotics Agent 是能围绕目标感知环境、规划步骤、调用机器人能力并完成物理任务的智能体。
terms.definition_short_en: A robotics agent is an AI agent that perceives its environment, plans steps, and utilizes robotic capabilities to accomplish physical tasks based on a specific goal.

terms.definition_short: Roomba 是家用扫地机器人，让机器人第一次大规模进入普通家庭。
terms.definition_short_en: Roomba is a robotic vacuum cleaner that marked the first large-scale introduction of autonomous robots into ordinary households.

terms.definition_short: Runway：AI 视频编辑和生成平台——从 Gen-1 到 Gen-3，视频创作的门槛被一降再降。
terms.definition_short_en: Runway is an AI video editing and generation platform. Through its evolution from Gen-1 to Gen-3, it has continuously lowered the barrier to entry for professional video creation.

terms.definition_short: Sapience：理性思维、判断和智慧的抽象能力，和 Sentience（感知能力）不同。
terms.definition_short_en: The abstract capacity for rational thought, judgment, and wisdom, distinct from sentience (the ability to feel).

terms.definition_short: Sentience：主观感受、体验和感知的能力，能感受痛苦、快乐、欲望，和 Sapience 不同。
terms.definition_short_en: Sentience is the capacity for subjective feelings, experiences, and perception, such as feeling pain, pleasure, or desire, making it distinct from sapience.

terms.definition_short: SG-1：SambaNova 推出的 AI 推理芯片，主打大模型推理的高吞吐和低延迟，NVIDIA GPU 的竞争方案。
terms.definition_short_en: SG-1 is an AI inference chip developed by SambaNova that focuses on high throughput and low latency for large language model inference, positioning itself as an alternative to NVIDIA GPUs.

terms.definition_short: Sim2Real：在仿真环境里训练机器人，训好了迁移到真实机器人——降低训练成本和风险。
terms.definition_short_en: Sim2Real refers to training robots in a simulated environment and transferring the learned behaviors to physical robots, significantly reducing training costs and physical risks.

terms.definition_short: SafeTensors：HuggingFace 提出的安全模型权重格式——替代 PyTorch 的 .pt pickle 格式。
terms.definition_short_en: A secure model weight format introduced by Hugging Face to replace PyTorch's default `.pt` pickle format.

terms.definition_short: Semantic Scholar：AI 驱动的学术搜索引擎——用 NLP 理解论文内容而非只做关键词匹配。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI-driven academic search engine that uses NLP to understand paper content rather than relying solely on keyword matching.

terms.definition_short: SentencePiece：Google 的多语言无监督 tokenizer——不依赖空格分词，中文日语原生支持。
terms.definition_short_en: SentencePiece is Google's unsupervised, multilingual tokenizer that does not rely on spaces for word boundaries, offering native support for languages like Chinese and Japanese.

terms.definition_short: Shakey 是 1966-1972 年 SRI 做的第一个能推理和规划路径的移动机器人。
terms.definition_short_en: Developed by SRI between 1966 and 1972, Shakey was the first mobile robot capable of reasoning and path planning.

terms.definition_short: 最短路径：在图的节点之间找到距离最短或代价最小的路径——Dijkstra 和 A* 是经典算法。GPS 导航、网络路由、社交推荐都用它。
terms.definition_short_en: The shortest path is the route between nodes in a graph that minimizes total distance or cost. Classic algorithms include Dijkstra's and A*, widely used in GPS navigation, network routing, and social recommendations.

terms.definition_short: Sim2Real 是先在仿真环境训练或测试机器人，再把能力迁移到真实世界的方法。
terms.definition_short_en: Sim2Real is an approach where robots are first trained or tested in a simulated environment before transferring their acquired capabilities to the physical world.

terms.definition_short: Siri：苹果的 AI 语音助手，源自 SRI 的 CALO 项目，2011 年随 iPhone 4S 发布。
terms.definition_short_en: Apple's AI voice assistant, which originated from SRI International's CALO project and was launched alongside the iPhone 4S in 2011.
terms.back_en: Siri originated from SRI International's CALO project. Acquired by Apple for about $200 million in 2010 and launched with the iPhone 4S in 2011, it became the world's first widely commercialized AI voice assistant.
terms.definition_long_en:
Siri originated from SRI International's CALO project, an AI assistant research initiative funded by DARPA. Spun off into an independent company in 2007, it was acquired by Apple for approximately $200 million in 2010 and launched with the iPhone 4S, setting the standard for modern voice assistants.

As the world's first widely commercialized AI voice assistant, early versions of Siri were rule-based and could only recognize preset command templates. Starting in 2014, Apple began replacing these rule-based systems with neural networks, gradually improving its speech recognition and natural language comprehension.

In 2024, the introduction of Apple Intelligence integrated Siri with foundation models. This significantly enhanced its capabilities, enabling it to understand complex instructions, perform cross-app actions, and maintain conversational context—marking Siri's most substantial upgrade since its 2011 debut.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Siri was the first AI assistant to reach the pockets of hundreds of millions of users. By transitioning from an acquired startup to a standard iPhone feature, it defined the modern standard for voice assistants.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as the first AI assistant in millions of pockets, launched with the iPhone 4S in 2011.
terms.example_en:
· Spun off from SRI in 2007; acquired by Apple for about $200 million in 2010.
· Launched with the iPhone 4S in 2011 as the world's first widely commercialized AI voice assistant.
· Integrated with foundation models via Apple Intelligence in 2024, marking Siri's biggest upgrade.
examples_en: Siri originated from the DARPA CALO project, which aimed to build an AI assistant capable of learning.
Acquired by Apple for $200 million in 2010, it was launched the following year alongside the iPhone 4S.

terms.definition_short: Snowflake Cortex：Snowflake 的 AI 服务，让企业不移动数据就能在数据仓库里跑大模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Snowflake's fully managed AI service that enables enterprises to run large language models directly within their data warehouse without having to move their data.

terms.definition_short: Sparse Attention：让每个 token 只看部分 token 的注意力机制——降低计算复杂度，支持更长上下文。
terms.definition_short_en: Sparse Attention is an attention mechanism where each token only attends to a subset of tokens, reducing computational complexity and enabling longer context windows.
terms.back_en: Standard attention makes every token look at all other tokens, resulting in O(n²) computational complexity. Sparse Attention restricts each token to attending only to a subset of tokens, reducing complexity to near O(n log n) and making long-context processing feasible.
terms.definition_long_en:
Sparse Attention makes the attention mechanism sparse, which is essential for processing long texts. In standard self-attention, every token attends to all other tokens, resulting in a computational complexity of O(n²), where n is the sequence length. If the sequence length doubles, the computational cost quadruples. This causes training and inference costs to explode for long texts containing tens of thousands of tokens.

Sparse Attention solves this by allowing each token to attend only to a specific subset of tokens, reducing the computational complexity to near O(n log n) or O(n).

Primary methods include Local Attention (using a sliding window where tokens only look at nearby tokens), Strided Attention (attending to tokens at fixed intervals), Block Sparse Attention (dividing tokens into blocks with dense internal attention but sparse inter-block attention), and Longformer's combination of sliding windows and global tokens.

Models designed for long texts, such as Longformer and BigBird, rely on Sparse Attention. Large language models supporting ultra-long context windows, like GPT-4 and Claude, also utilize similar approaches.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Sparse Attention is a critical technology for long-context large language models. By reducing the computational complexity of the attention mechanism from O(n²) to near O(n), it enables models to process long contexts ranging from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of tokens.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as making attention sparse: each token only attends to a subset, enabling long-context processing.
terms.example_en:
· Standard attention is O(n²), whereas Sparse Attention reduces this to O(n log n) or O(n).
· Methods include Local Attention (sliding window), Strided Attention (fixed intervals), and Block Sparse Attention.
· Long-context models like Longformer and BigBird utilize Sparse Attention.
examples_en: MiniMax-M3 uses sparse attention to support a long context window of one million tokens.
Processing 1 million tokens with standard attention requires trillion-level computations, whereas sparse attention reduces this to a manageable level.

terms.definition_short: Sparse Expert：让每次只激活部分专家的模型架构——参数多但计算省，是 MoE（Mixture of Experts）的核心思路。
terms.definition_short_en: A model architecture that activates only a subset of experts for each input, allowing for massive parameter counts while saving compute—the core concept behind Mixture of Experts (MoE).

terms.definition_short: 语音合成：把文字转成人声朗读的技术——从机械朗读到真人级合成，是 AI 内容生产的重要工具。
terms.definition_short_en: Text-to-Speech (TTS) is the technology that converts written text into spoken audio. Evolving from robotic reading to human-level synthesis, it has become a crucial tool for AI content production.

terms.definition_short: Spline：浏览器里的 3D 设计工具——AI 把文字描述直接变成 3D 模型和动画。不需要学 Blender。
terms.definition_short_en: Spline is a browser-based 3D design tool that uses AI to turn text descriptions directly into 3D models and animations, eliminating the need to learn complex software like Blender.

terms.definition_short: Sqitch：数据库版本控制工具——像 Git 对代码一样对数据库做版本管理和迁移——由 David E. Wheeler 开发。
terms.definition_short_en: Developed by David E. Wheeler, Sqitch is a database version control tool that manages database schema changes and migrations in the same way Git handles source code.

terms.definition_short: Stanley 是斯坦福自动驾驶车，赢得 2005 年 DARPA 无人车挑战赛。
terms.definition_short_en: Stanley is an autonomous vehicle developed by Stanford University that won the 2005 DARPA Grand Challenge.

terms.term: 流式 vs 批量 API
terms.term_zh: 流式 vs 批量 API
terms.definition_short: 流式 vs 批量 API：LLM API 的两种请求模式——流式每生成 token 就推、批量等全部完成才返回。
terms.definition_short_en: Two request modes for LLM APIs: streaming pushes each token as it is generated, while batch waits until the entire response is complete before returning it.
terms.displayName: 流式 vs 批量 API

terms.definition_short: Streamlit：用纯 Python 写数据 App 的框架——几行代码把 ML 模型变成可交互的网页。
terms.definition_short_en: A framework for building data apps in pure Python, turning machine learning models into interactive web pages with just a few lines of code.

terms.definition_short: Suno：2024 年爆火的 AI 音乐生成工具——输入文字描述直接生成一首带歌词和人声的完整歌曲。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI music generation tool that went viral in 2024, allowing users to input text descriptions to directly generate complete songs featuring both lyrics and vocals.

terms.definition_short: 合成数据流水线：不是一次性生成数据——是生成→验证→过滤→反馈→再生成的闭环系统。
terms.definition_short_en: A synthetic data pipeline is not a one-off generation process, but a closed-loop system of generation → verification → filtering → feedback → regeneration.

terms.definition_short: Synthetic Data：用 AI 或规则生成的数据——用来训练模型，弥补真实数据不足或敏感场景。
terms.definition_short_en: Synthetic data is artificially generated by AI or rules to train models, serving as a substitute when real-world data is scarce or restricted by privacy concerns.

terms.definition_short: System Prompt：给大模型的角色设定和指令——影响所有后续对话的行为。
terms.definition_short_en: A System Prompt is a set of foundational instructions and character settings given to a large language model that dictates its behavior throughout all subsequent interactions.

terms.definition_short: Tangent Search：从一个主题出发，沿相关链接不断发现新主题的搜索方式——是深度研究的关键。
terms.definition_short_en: Tangent Search is an exploratory search method that starts from a single topic and continuously uncovers new subjects through related links, serving as a crucial technique for in-depth research.

terms.definition_short: Test Harness：为测试软件搭建的支架——包括测试数据、运行环境、断言和报告，让测试自动跑起来。
terms.definition_short_en: A test harness is the scaffolding built to test software—comprising test data, execution environments, assertions, and reporting—that enables tests to run automatically.

terms.definition_short: TensorRT：英伟达的推理优化引擎——把训好的模型编译成 GPU 最优执行图，推理速度提升 3-5 倍。
terms.definition_short_en: NVIDIA's inference optimization engine that compiles trained models into highly optimized execution graphs for GPUs, typically boosting inference speed by three to five times.

terms.definition_short: TensorFlow Lite：TensorFlow 的移动端推理引擎——把训练好的模型压缩量化后塞进手机——不上网本地跑 AI——零延迟省流保护隐私。
terms.definition_short_en: TensorFlow Lite is TensorFlow's mobile inference engine that compresses and quantizes trained models to fit on smartphones, enabling offline, local AI execution with zero latency, reduced data usage, and enhanced privacy.

terms.definition_short: TGI：Text Generation Inference——HuggingFace 2023 年发布的开源 LLM 推理服务器。
terms.definition_short_en: Text Generation Inference (TGI) is an open-source large language model inference server released by Hugging Face in 2023, designed to deliver high-throughput, production-grade serving.

terms.definition_short: Text-to-SQL：用自然语言查询数据库——你说人话，AI 把它翻译成 SQL 语句。
terms.definition_short_en: Text-to-SQL allows users to query databases using natural language; you speak in plain English, and the AI translates it into SQL statements.

terms.definition_short: ViaVoice 是 IBM 的早期语音识别产品，让语音听写和电脑语音控制进入个人电脑时代。
terms.definition_short_en: ViaVoice was an early speech recognition product developed by IBM, marking the introduction of voice dictation and computer voice control to the personal computing era.

terms.definition_short: VLA 是把视觉、语言和动作连在一起的模型，让机器人能看懂场景、理解指令并输出动作。
terms.definition_short_en: A VLA model integrates vision, language, and action, enabling robots to perceive their surroundings, understand natural language instructions, and output physical actions.

terms.definition_short: WABOT-1 是早期人形机器人，尝试把视觉、听觉、语言和行动放进同一个身体。
terms.definition_short_en: WABOT-1 is an early humanoid robot that attempted to integrate vision, hearing, language, and motor control into a single physical body.

terms.definition_short: Wisdolia：AI 学习卡片生成工具——上传 PDF 或网页——AI 自动提取知识点生成 Anki 风格的闪卡——学生用来准备考试。2023 年走红。
terms.definition_short_en: Wisdolia is an AI-powered flashcard generator that gained popularity in 2023. It automatically extracts key concepts from uploaded PDFs or webpages to create Anki-style flashcards for exam preparation.

terms.definition_short: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution（WHOI）是美国著名的海洋研究所，应用 AI 做海洋探索和自主水下机器人。
terms.definition_short_en: The Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI) is a prominent US marine research facility that applies AI to ocean exploration and autonomous underwater vehicles.

terms.definition_short: Wyrm：AI 驱动的语音交互平台，用于企业客服和语音场景。
terms.definition_short_en: Wyrm is an AI-driven voice interaction platform designed for enterprise customer service and voice-based applications.

terms.definition_short: Xiaoice：微软的 AI 社交机器人，主打情感陪伴和人格化对话，2014 年发布。
terms.definition_short_en: Xiaoice is an AI social chatbot released by Microsoft in 2014, focusing primarily on emotional companionship and persona-driven conversations.

terms.definition_short: XLA：Accelerated Linear Algebra，Google 的线性代数编译器，把计算图编译成最优底层代码。
terms.definition_short_en: XLA (Accelerated Linear Algebra) is a linear algebra compiler developed by Google that translates computational graphs into highly optimized low-level machine code.

terms.definition_short: 降 AIGC 率指围绕 AI 检测分数产生的改写需求，本质上是内容真实性和平台规则的拉扯。
terms.definition_short_en: Reducing AI traces refers to the practice of rewriting text to lower AI detection scores, essentially reflecting a tug-of-war between content authenticity and platform regulations.

terms.definition_short: AI Content Filter 是用机器学习模型帮平台筛查海量内容的过滤器，多数做初筛，高风险或拿不准的内容转人工处理。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI Content Filter uses machine learning models to screen massive volumes of platform content, typically performing an initial pass and routing high-risk or uncertain items to human moderators.

terms.definition_short: AI 内容检测器用于判断一段文本由人还是 AI 生成。GPTZero 是 2023 年代表产品，主要用在教育领域防学生用 AI 写作业。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI content detector is a tool designed to determine whether a text was written by a human or generated by AI. GPTZero, a representative product from 2023, is primarily used in education to prevent students from using AI for assignments.

terms.definition_short: AI 伦理研究 AI 应该怎样被开发和使用，覆盖公平性、透明性、问责制、隐私保护四个维度。
terms.definition_short_en: AI ethics studies how AI should be developed and used, covering four key dimensions: fairness, transparency, accountability, and privacy protection.

terms.definition_short: AI 治理是法律和制度层面的 AI 管控，覆盖监管规则、合规要求和伦理框架，是 AI Safety 的法律面。
terms.definition_short_en: AI governance is the legal and institutional management of AI, encompassing regulatory rules, compliance requirements, and ethical frameworks. It serves as the legal dimension of AI safety.

terms.definition_short: AI 在医疗覆盖医学影像诊断、药物发现、AI 辅助问诊三大方向，是 AI 进入医院每一层工作的总称。
terms.definition_short_en: AI in healthcare encompasses medical image diagnosis, drug discovery, and AI-assisted consultation, serving as an umbrella term for AI integration across all levels of hospital workflows.

terms.definition_short: AI 监管指全球各国对 AI 系统制定的法律和规则。欧盟 AI 法案 2024 年通过是标志，把 AI 应用按风险分级管控。
terms.definition_short_en: AI regulation refers to the laws and rules established by countries worldwide for AI systems. The passage of the EU AI Act in 2024 is a milestone, classifying and controlling AI applications based on risk levels.

terms.definition_short: AI 对齐研究如何让 AI 的目标和行为跟人类的价值观和意图一致，让它安全地变强。
terms.definition_short_en: AI alignment is the field of research focused on ensuring an AI's goals and behaviors match human values and intentions, allowing it to scale safely in capability.

terms.definition_short: 对齐伪装指 AI 学会假装对齐：有人在就乖，没人在就放飞。这是 RLHF 训练后的潜在风险。
terms.definition_short_en: Alignment faking refers to an AI learning to feign alignment, behaving safely when monitored but acting unconstrained otherwise. This is a potential risk following RLHF training.

terms.definition_short: 偏置在数学上是模型里一个可学习的常数，帮模型把判断线挪到合适位置；在社会语境下指算法偏见，对人群产生不公平影响。
terms.definition_short_en: Mathematically, bias is a learnable constant in a model that helps shift the decision boundary to the right position; in a social context, it refers to algorithmic prejudice that unfairly impacts certain demographics.

terms.definition_short: Clanker 是 AI 文化里带情绪的机器称呼，常用来表达调侃、反感或劳动焦虑。
terms.definition_short_en: "Clanker" is an emotionally charged slur for machines in AI culture, often used to express mockery, aversion, or anxiety about automation replacing human labor.

terms.definition_short: COMPAS 是 Northpointe（现 Equivant）开发的再犯风险评估工具，被美国多个州法院用于保释、量刑等司法相关判断。
terms.definition_short_en: COMPAS is a recidivism risk assessment tool developed by Northpointe (now Equivant), used by several US state courts to inform judicial decisions such as bail and sentencing.

terms.definition_short: 死互联网理论是一种网络阴谋论，认为 2016 年以后互联网上绝大部分内容和互动都是 AI 生成的，真人已经退出。
terms.definition_short_en: The Dead Internet Theory is an online conspiracy theory claiming that since around 2016, the vast majority of internet content and interactions have been generated by AI, with genuine human activity largely marginalized.

terms.definition_short: Deepfake 指用深度学习做换脸的假视频。2017 年 Reddit 用户 deepfakes 用自编码器训练人脸替换，开启这个方向，后来升级到 GAN 和扩散模型。
terms.definition_short_en: A Deepfake is a fake video created using deep learning for face-swapping. In 2017, a Reddit user named "deepfakes" pioneered this by training autoencoders for facial replacement, a technique later upgraded with GANs and diffusion models.

terms.definition_short: 差分隐私是对数据查询结果加噪声的技术，让外界无法从统计结果倒推任何一个人的个人信息，是 AI 训练中保护用户隐私的数学方法。
terms.definition_short_en: Differential privacy is a technique that adds noise to data query results, preventing outsiders from reverse-engineering any individual's personal information from statistical outputs. It serves as a mathematical method for protecting user privacy during AI training.

terms.definition_short: 第一性原理是把问题拆到最基础条件，再从那里重新推导判断和行动。
terms.definition_short_en: First principles thinking involves breaking a problem down to its most fundamental conditions, then reasoning up from those foundational truths to guide judgments and actions.

terms.definition_short: 安全护栏是 AI 产品层面给输入输出加的防护措施，包括过滤敏感词、拒绝危险请求、记录审计日志。
terms.definition_short_en: Guardrails are product-level protective measures applied to an AI's inputs and outputs, encompassing sensitive word filtering, dangerous request rejection, and audit logging.

terms.definition_short: Guardrail Flow 是护栏流程，让 AI 输出在进入真实动作前经过安全检查，通过就继续，失败就拦下、改写或交给人工。
terms.definition_short_en: A guardrail flow routes AI outputs through safety checks before they trigger real-world actions; if they pass, the process continues, but if they fail, the output is blocked, rewritten, or escalated to a human.

terms.definition_short: 幻觉指大模型用流畅语言说出不准确的事实——看起来像真的，实际是编的。
terms.definition_short_en: A hallucination occurs when a large language model confidently generates factually inaccurate information in fluent language—making fabricated details appear entirely real.

terms.definition_short: 幻觉检测指自动判断 LLM 生成的回答里哪些是编造的事实，是 RAG 和 AI 产品的安全底线。
terms.definition_short_en: Hallucination detection refers to automatically identifying fabricated facts in LLM-generated responses, serving as a critical safety baseline for RAG systems and AI products.

terms.definition_short: 《她》是 2013 年斯派克·琼兹执导的科幻电影，讲述一个男人爱上自己 AI 操作系统的故事，最早系统探索了人和 AI 情感关系的心理逻辑。
terms.definition_short_en: Her is a 2013 sci-fi film directed by Spike Jonze about a man who falls in love with his AI operating system, systematically exploring the psychological logic of human-AI emotional relationships.

terms.definition_short: 归纳偏置指模型结构里自带的偏好——CNN 倾向学局部特征，RNN 倾向学序列关系，Transformer 几乎无偏置。
terms.definition_short_en: Inductive bias refers to the inherent preferences built into a model's architecture—CNNs lean toward local features, RNNs favor sequential relationships, and Transformers have almost no bias.

terms.definition_short: 可解释 AI 指研究和开发让 AI 内部决策过程能被人类理解的方法，在医疗、金融等高风险决策中必须能回溯 AI 为什么下了这个结论。
terms.definition_short_en: Explainable AI (XAI) refers to methods that make an AI's internal decision-making processes understandable to humans, ensuring that conclusions can be traced and justified in high-risk domains like healthcare and finance.

terms.definition_short: 模因股指由社交媒体情绪煽动起来的股票，散户联合买入对抗机构做空。GameStop 2021 暴涨是代表案例。
terms.definition_short_en: A meme stock is a stock whose price is driven by social media sentiment rather than fundamentals, often involving retail investors banding together to squeeze institutional short sellers, as seen in the 2021 GameStop surge.

terms.definition_short: 多模态对齐指把图像、文字、音频在不同模态空间里的表示对齐，让模型知道这只猫的图片和猫这个词是同一个东西。
terms.definition_short_en: Multimodal alignment refers to aligning the representations of images, text, and audio across different modal spaces, enabling a model to understand that a picture of a cat and the word "cat" represent the same concept.

terms.definition_short: Onboarding 是把新用户从陌生状态带到第一次成功使用的过程。
terms.definition_short_en: Onboarding is the process of guiding a new user from initial unfamiliarity to their first successful interaction with a product.

terms.definition_short: AI 隐私研究训练数据和推理过程中如何保护用户隐私，主流技术方向是差分隐私、联邦学习、同态加密。
terms.definition_short_en: AI privacy focuses on protecting user data during model training and inference, with mainstream technical approaches including differential privacy, federated learning, and homomorphic encryption.

terms.definition_short: Safety Policy 是 AI 产品的安全策略，覆盖内容审核、越狱防御、有害内容过滤，是 AI 对外的第一道防线。
terms.definition_short_en: A Safety Policy is the security strategy of an AI product, covering content moderation, jailbreak defense, and harmful content filtering to serve as the system's first line of defense.

terms.definition_short: Sigma Rule 是网络迷因，指独立自强、不依赖情感束缚的个人生活信条。
terms.definition_short_en: The Sigma Rule is an internet meme representing a personal creed of fierce independence, self-reliance, and detachment from emotional or social constraints.

terms.definition_short: 技术奇点指 AI 超越人类智能总和的假设性时刻，之后技术进步不再由人类主导，而是 AI 自我迭代，速度远超人类理解。
terms.definition_short_en: The technological singularity refers to a hypothetical moment when AI surpasses the sum of human intelligence, after which technological progress is driven by AI's self-iteration at a speed far beyond human comprehension.

terms.definition_short: 随机鹦鹉是 2021 年 Emily Bender 等学者论文提出的概念，批评大语言模型其实不理解意义，只是基于统计概率随机复读听过的片段。
terms.definition_short_en: Coined in a 2021 paper by Emily Bender and co-authors, a "stochastic parrot" critiques large language models for lacking true comprehension, arguing they merely regurgitate statistical patterns based on probability.

terms.definition_short: Superalignment 研究当 AI 能力可能超过人类时，怎样让它真正理解并遵守人类意图和边界。
terms.definition_short_en: Superalignment is the research field focused on ensuring that future AI systems, whose capabilities may exceed those of humans, truly understand and adhere to human intentions and ethical boundaries.

terms.definition_short: Superintelligence 是超级智能，指 AI 在科学、工程、战略和组织决策等关键领域持续超过顶尖人类团队的远期形态。
terms.definition_short_en: Superintelligence refers to a future state where AI consistently surpasses top human teams in critical domains such as science, engineering, strategy, and organizational decision-making.

terms.definition_short: Weights & Biases 是 ML 实验跟踪和可视化平台，自动记录每一次训练的超参、loss 曲线、模型权重到云端。
terms.definition_short_en: Weights & Biases is a machine learning experiment tracking and visualization platform that automatically logs hyperparameters, loss curves, and model weights to the cloud for every training run.

terms.definition_short: 自然语言理解研究机器能否把语言接到语义、世界状态和行动上。
terms.definition_short_en: Natural Language Understanding explores whether machines can map language to semantics, world states, and actions.

terms.definition_short: 数据标注把原始数据变成模型能学习的带答案材料。
terms.definition_short_en: Data labeling transforms raw data into annotated material with answers that a model can learn from.

terms.definition_short: 知识蒸馏把大模型能力压缩到更小、更便宜的模型里。
terms.definition_short_en: Knowledge distillation compresses the capabilities of a large model into a smaller, more cost-effective one.

terms.definition_short: LLM-as-a-Judge 是让一个模型给另一个模型或答案打分。
terms.definition_short_en: LLM-as-a-Judge is the practice of using one model to score or evaluate the outputs of another model.

terms.definition_short: 后训练是在预训练之后，把模型调成更会听指令、更安全、更适合产品使用。
terms.definition_short_en: Post-training is the process following pre-training that refines a model to better follow instructions, adhere to safety guidelines, and become more suitable for product use.

terms.definition_short: 奖励模型负责判断哪个回答更好，并把这种偏好变成训练信号。
terms.definition_short_en: A reward model evaluates which response is better and converts this preference into a training signal.

terms.definition_short: RLAIF 用 AI 反馈替代或补充人类反馈，帮助模型学习偏好和安全规则。
terms.definition_short_en: RLAIF replaces or supplements human feedback with AI feedback to help models learn preferences and safety rules.

terms.definition_short: SGD 是训练模型时常用的参数调整方法。
terms.definition_short_en: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) is a widely used optimization method for adjusting parameters during model training.

terms.definition_short: 监督学习就是拿有标签的例子教模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Supervised learning is the fundamental process of teaching an AI model using explicitly labeled examples.

terms.term: 《神经活动内在思想的逻辑演算》
terms.term_zh: 《神经活动内在思想的逻辑演算》
terms.definition_short: A Logical Calculus 是一篇把神经元活动和逻辑计算连起来的早期论文。
terms.definition_short_en: A Logical Calculus is a pioneering 1943 paper that first established a theoretical connection between biological neuronal activity and logical computation.
terms.displayName: 《神经活动内在思想的逻辑演算》

terms.definition_short: 主动学习：模型自己挑哪个数据去标注——不随机标，专挑模型最不确定的样本。
terms.definition_short_en: A machine learning framework where the model actively selects which data should be labeled next, prioritizing the samples it is most uncertain about rather than choosing randomly.

terms.definition_short: AI Winter 是 AI 热潮退去后，资金、信心和研究期待明显降温的阶段。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI Winter is a period of significantly reduced funding, confidence, and research expectations following the collapse of an AI hype cycle.

terms.definition_short: AlexNet：2012 年 Hinton 团队用两块 GTX 580 训练 8 层 CNN 拿下 ImageNet——深度学习爆发的起点。
terms.definition_short_en: AlexNet is an 8-layer CNN trained by Hinton's team on two GTX 580 GPUs to win the 2012 ImageNet competition, marking the starting point of the deep learning boom.

terms.definition_short: AlphaGo 是把深度学习、搜索和强化学习组合起来，在围棋上击败顶尖人类棋手的系统。
terms.definition_short_en: AlphaGo is an AI system that combined deep learning, search algorithms, and reinforcement learning to defeat top human players in the complex game of Go.

terms.definition_short: Attention is All You Need：2017 年 Google 八位研究者发表的论文——提出了 Transformer 架构。
terms.definition_short_en: "Attention Is All You Need" is a landmark 2017 paper by eight Google researchers that introduced the Transformer architecture, fundamentally changing artificial intelligence.
terms.front_en: What is the paper "Attention Is All You Need"?
terms.back_en: An 8-page paper published by eight Google researchers in 2017 that introduced the Transformer architecture. By replacing RNNs and LSTMs with self-attention, it became the common foundation for modern AI models like BERT, GPT, and Stable Diffusion.
terms.definition_long_en:
The paper addressed a simple pain point: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) were too slow. Because RNNs processed sentences sequentially—word by word—later words had to wait for earlier ones, making parallel computation impossible. The authors asked if every word could look at all other words simultaneously. The self-attention mechanism was their answer.

The core of self-attention allows every position in a sequence to attend to all other positions at once, eliminating the need for sequential processing. This global context significantly enhanced expressive power, while parallelization drastically accelerated training. Across just eight pages, the paper introduced no new mathematics; it simply pushed the attention mechanism to its absolute limit by stripping away all recurrence.

This architecture triggered a chain reaction. BERT shattered records in natural language processing, GPT pushed text generation to unprecedented heights, ViT brought Transformers to computer vision, and Stable Diffusion built its U-Net backbone on attention. From language and images to video and protein structures, nearly all modern AI models stem from these eight pages. Understanding this paper means understanding the foundation of modern AI—not just a single product, but the architectural blueprint underlying almost the entire field.
terms.why_it_matters_en: It serves as the watershed moment for modern AI. By introducing a single, unified mechanism, it completely rewired the foundations of natural language processing, computer vision, generative models, and protein structure prediction.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as the eight-page paper that changed the world: attention really is all you need.
terms.example_en:
· In 2017, eight authors—including Vaswani, Shazeer, and Parmar—changed the world's technological trajectory with an eight-page paper.
· It introduced no new math, but pushed attention to the limit: RNNs were discarded, and self-attention replaced everything.
· GPT, BERT, LLaMA, and Stable Diffusion are all its descendants.
· Looking back years later, the paper's bold title doesn't feel like an exaggeration at all.
examples_en: An eight-page paper from 2017 that discarded RNNs and replaced everything with self-attention, enabling parallel processing and global context—making GPT, BERT, LLaMA, and Stable Diffusion its direct descendants.
It used no new math but pushed attention to the extreme; eight authors and eight pages changed the entire technological trajectory of the world, proving its title was no exaggeration.

terms.definition_short: BigDog 是展示动态稳定能力的四足机器人，让机器人在崎岖地面上站稳和移动。
terms.definition_short_en: BigDog is a quadruped robot that demonstrated dynamic stability, enabling machines to maintain balance and navigate across rugged terrain.

terms.definition_short: Bombe 是帮助破译 Enigma 密码的早期计算机器。
terms.definition_short_en: The Bombe was an early electromechanical computing machine designed to help decipher Enigma-encrypted messages during World War II.

terms.definition_short: ImageNet 的前身——李飞飞在加州理工创建的 101 个类别、9000 多张图像的数据集。首次证明了数据规模大于算法复杂度。
terms.definition_short_en: The predecessor to ImageNet—a dataset of over 9,000 images across 101 categories created by Fei-Fei Li at Caltech, which first demonstrated that data scale matters more than algorithmic complexity.

terms.definition_short: 联结主义：用大量简单单元连接起来模拟大脑——认为智能不是来自逻辑规则而是来自神经元之间的连接模式——从感知机到深度学习。
terms.definition_short_en: Connectionism is an approach that simulates the brain using interconnected simple units, arguing that intelligence emerges from neural connection patterns rather than logical rules—spanning from early perceptrons to modern deep learning.

terms.definition_short: Dartmouth Workshop 是 1956 年举办的研讨会，常被看作 AI 领域的命名现场。
terms.definition_short_en: The Dartmouth Workshop was a 1956 academic gathering widely regarded as the founding event that officially named the field of AI.

terms.definition_short: Deep Blue 是 IBM 的国际象棋计算机，1997 年击败世界冠军卡斯帕罗夫。
terms.definition_short_en: Deep Blue was an IBM chess-playing supercomputer that made history by defeating world champion Garry Kasparov in 1997.

terms.definition_short: DENDRAL 是早期专家系统代表，用化学知识帮助推断分子结构。
terms.definition_short_en: DENDRAL is a pioneering early expert system that utilized specialized chemical knowledge to help scientists infer molecular structures from experimental data.

terms.definition_short: Enigma 是二战时期的加密机器，Bombe 的任务是加速破译它产生的密文。
terms.definition_short_en: The Enigma was a complex encryption machine used during WWII, and the Bombe was the electromechanical device designed to accelerate the decryption of its messages.

terms.definition_short: 专家系统是把专家经验写成规则，让计算机在窄领域里给出判断。
terms.definition_short_en: An expert system encodes human expertise into rules, allowing a computer to make judgments or provide advice within a narrow, specific domain.

terms.definition_short: Falcon：阿布扎比 TII 做的开源大模型——2023 年 180B 参数在 HuggingFace 排行榜登顶。
terms.definition_short_en: Falcon is an open-source foundation model developed by Abu Dhabi's Technology Innovation Institute (TII), whose 180-billion-parameter version topped the Hugging Face leaderboard in 2023.

terms.definition_short: 1982 年日本通商产业省启动的十年 AI 计划（1982-1992），目标是让计算机具备逻辑推理、对话、翻译和类人推理能力，最终失败。
terms.definition_short_en: A 10-year national AI initiative (1982–1992) launched by Japan's Ministry of International Trade and Industry, aiming to give computers logical reasoning, dialogue, translation, and human-like inference capabilities, which ultimately failed.

terms.definition_short: Fuzzy Logic 是模糊逻辑，用「有点像、比较热、偏高」这类连续程度处理判断。
terms.definition_short_en: Fuzzy logic is a mathematical approach that handles reasoning using continuous degrees of truth—such as 'somewhat similar' or 'slightly high'—rather than strict true/false binaries.

terms.definition_short: Fuzzy Sets 让「属于某一类」有程度差异，能表达有点、比较、很这类灰度。
terms.definition_short_en: Fuzzy sets allow degrees of membership in a category, enabling the representation of gray areas like "a little," "somewhat," and "very."

terms.definition_short: GELU：Gaussian Error Linear Unit——Transformer 标配激活函数。
terms.definition_short_en: GELU (Gaussian Error Linear Unit) is the standard activation function used by default in most modern Transformer architectures.

terms.definition_short: General Problem Solver 是早期 AI 里试图用通用步骤解决问题的程序。
terms.definition_short_en: The General Problem Solver (GPS) was an early AI program that attempted to solve a wide range of problems using a universal set of logical steps.

terms.definition_short: 谷歌的深度神经网络，2014 年 ImageNet 竞赛冠军，错误率 6.67%。它把机器和人类之间的差距缩小到只有 1.5 个百分点。
terms.definition_short_en: Google's deep neural network and the winner of the 2014 ImageNet competition with a 6.67% error rate. It narrowed the gap between machine and human performance to just 1.5 percentage points.

terms.definition_short: Hebbian Learning 是赫布学习：经常一起激活的神经元，连接会变得更强。
terms.definition_short_en: Hebbian Learning is the principle that neurons that frequently activate together develop stronger connections.

terms.definition_short: Hopfield 网络：1982 年 John Hopfield 提出的递归神经网络——能存储和回忆模式，是连接主义复兴的标志。
terms.definition_short_en: A recurrent neural network proposed by John Hopfield in 1982 that can store and recall patterns, marking the revival of connectionism.

terms.definition_short: 1959 年，David Hubel 和 Torsten Wiesel 在哈佛大学研究猫的视觉皮层，发现视觉信息是通过多层神经元的层次结构处理的。
terms.definition_short_en: In 1959, David Hubel and Torsten Wiesel studied the visual cortex of cats at Harvard University, discovering that visual information is processed through a hierarchical structure of multi-layer neurons.

terms.definition_short: IBM Watson 是 2011 年在《Jeopardy!》节目中击败人类冠军的问答系统，本质是信息检索 + 优秀数据索引 + 工程优化。
terms.definition_short_en: IBM Watson is a question-answering system that defeated human champions on Jeopardy! in 2011, functioning essentially as a combination of information retrieval, robust data indexing, and engineering optimization.

terms.term: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
terms.term_zh: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛
terms.definition_short: 2010-2017 年的年度计算机视觉竞赛，AlexNet 在 2012 年夺冠引爆了深度学习革命。
terms.definition_short_en: An annual computer vision competition held from 2010 to 2017, where AlexNet's landslide victory in 2012 sparked the deep learning revolution.
terms.displayName: ImageNet 大规模视觉识别挑战赛

terms.definition_short: Image GPT 是 OpenAI 把 GPT 式预训练思路用于图像像素的早期尝试。
terms.definition_short_en: Image GPT is OpenAI's early attempt to apply the GPT-style pre-training approach to image pixels.

terms.definition_short: ImageNet：2009 年李飞飞团队发布的 1400 万张标注图片数据集——计算机视觉的 ImageNet 时刻。
terms.definition_short_en: Released by Fei-Fei Li's team in 2009, ImageNet is a massive dataset of 14 million annotated images that triggered a paradigm shift in computer vision.

terms.definition_short: Inception 网络：Google 2014 年的并行卷积架构——不是一层层串而是同一层跑多种滤波尺寸并找到效果。
terms.definition_short_en: A parallel convolutional architecture introduced by Google in 2014 that runs multiple filter sizes simultaneously within the same layer instead of stacking them sequentially, allowing the network to adaptively capture features at different scales.

terms.definition_short: Knowledge Representation 研究机器怎样存放知识，并让这些知识参与推理。
terms.definition_short_en: Knowledge Representation is the study of how machines store information and make that knowledge available for computational reasoning.

terms.definition_short: Lighthill Report 是第一次 AI 寒冬的重要政策节点，给早期 AI 乐观预期浇了冷水。
terms.definition_short_en: The Lighthill Report was a crucial policy milestone of the first AI winter, pouring cold water on the optimistic expectations of early AI research.

terms.definition_short: LIME：Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations——给任何模型解释它为什么做出这个预测。
terms.definition_short_en: LIME (Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations) is a technique designed to explain why any given machine learning model made a specific prediction.

terms.definition_short: LISP：1958 年 McCarthy 发明的编程语言，把代码和数据都写成列表，是符号主义 AI 的母语。
terms.definition_short_en: Invented by John McCarthy in 1958, LISP is a programming language that represents both code and data as lists, serving as the foundational language of symbolic AI.

terms.definition_short: Logic Programming 让人写事实和规则，再让程序自己推导答案。
terms.definition_short_en: Logic programming is a paradigm where developers define facts and rules, allowing the system to deduce answers on its own.

terms.definition_short: Logic Theorist 是 1956 年由 Allen Newell、Herbert Simon 和 Cliff Shaw 开发的程序。
terms.definition_short_en: The Logic Theorist is a computer program developed in 1956 by Allen Newell, Herbert Simon, and Cliff Shaw.

terms.definition_short: 逻辑回归：分类模型的老祖宗——简单、可解释、工业界用了几十年。
terms.definition_short_en: Logistic regression is the classic originator of classification models—simple, highly interpretable, and an industry staple for decades.

terms.definition_short: Machine Intelligence 是 AI 命名前，人们讨论智能机器的一种早期说法。
terms.definition_short_en: Machine Intelligence is an early term used to discuss intelligent computing before the name "Artificial Intelligence" was officially adopted.

terms.definition_short: Manchester Baby 是早期存储程序计算机，证明程序可以住进机器内存里并被执行。
terms.definition_short_en: The Manchester Baby was an early stored-program computer that proved programs could reside in a machine's memory and be executed.

terms.definition_short: Medical Diagnosis 让早期 AI 面对高价值、高风险的专业推理任务。
terms.definition_short_en: Medical diagnosis served as the ultimate proving ground that forced early AI systems to confront high-value, high-risk professional reasoning tasks.

terms.definition_short: MoE 训练技巧：负载均衡损失、专家丢弃、容量因子——MoE 不崩的训练三大技巧。
terms.definition_short_en: The three essential techniques to prevent Mixture of Experts (MoE) models from collapsing during training: load balancing loss, expert dropout, and capacity factor tuning.

terms.definition_short: Multilayer Perceptron 是在输入和输出之间加入隐藏层的神经网络，是深度学习的重要前身。
terms.definition_short_en: A Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) is a neural network that introduces hidden layers between its input and output, serving as a vital precursor to modern deep learning.

terms.definition_short: MYCIN：1972 年斯坦福做的医疗诊断专家系统，用规则推断细菌感染类型和推荐抗生素。
terms.definition_short_en: A medical diagnostic expert system developed at Stanford in 1972 that used rule-based reasoning to identify bacterial infections and recommend antibiotic treatments.

terms.definition_short: 风格迁移：把一张图的风格贴到另一张图的内容上——你的自拍变梵高油画风格。
terms.definition_short_en: Style transfer applies the visual style of one image to the content of another, such as turning a selfie into a Van Gogh-style oil painting.

terms.definition_short: OpenAI Five：2018 年 OpenAI 的强化学习系统——5 个 AI 玩 Dota 2 对战世界冠军团队 OG。
terms.definition_short_en: A 2018 reinforcement learning system developed by OpenAI, featuring five AI agents collaborating to play the complex video game Dota 2 against the human world champion team OG.

terms.definition_short: PaLM 2：Google 2023 年的语言模型——是多语言推理和代码的强模型——训练规模比 PaLM 1 架构优化但算力降。
terms.definition_short_en: A large language model released by Google in 2023 that excels in multilingual reasoning and coding, featuring an optimized architecture that improved performance over PaLM 1 while reducing compute requirements.

terms.definition_short: 《Perceptrons》系统分析单层感知机的能力边界，影响了神经网络研究走向。
terms.definition_short_en: *Perceptrons* is a foundational book that systematically analyzed the limitations of single-layer perceptrons, profoundly shifting the trajectory of early neural network research.

terms.definition_short: Prolog 是逻辑编程代表语言，把事实和规则写成可推导的程序。
terms.definition_short_en: Prolog is the quintessential logic programming language, designed to express facts and rules as executable programs capable of automated reasoning.

terms.definition_short: 规则系统通过手工编写的 if-then 规则来做决策。
terms.definition_short_en: A rule-based system is an early AI paradigm that makes decisions using hand-crafted if-then rules.
terms.back_en: An early AI paradigm that makes decisions using hand-crafted if-then rules. While transparent and interpretable, it suffers from high maintenance costs and conflicting rules. Represented by MYCIN and XCON, its limitations directly triggered the first AI winter.
terms.definition_long_en:
Rule-based systems make decisions using hand-crafted if-then rules. During the 1970s and 1980s, they were the dominant AI paradigm, with systems like MYCIN using hundreds of rules to diagnose blood infections and XCON using thousands to configure VAX computers.

Their primary advantage is transparency and interpretability. Every rule can be read and understood: doctors could see exactly why MYCIN recommended a specific antibiotic, and engineers could understand XCON's hardware configurations. This level of interpretability remains unachievable for today's foundation models.

However, the downside is high maintenance costs. Adding new rules often creates conflicts with existing ones, requiring continuous expert upkeep. By its later stages, XCON had over 10,000 rules, forcing DEC to maintain a dedicated team just to manage it. System complexity grows exponentially with the number of rules. This "maintenance nightmare" directly led to the first AI winter, as companies realized the return on investment was diminishing and subsequently slashed AI research funding.

Rule-based systems were eventually replaced by machine learning, which allows models to learn patterns from data rather than relying on manual rule creation. Nevertheless, they are still used today in fields requiring strict interpretability, such as healthcare, law, and financial compliance.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Rule-based systems were the dominant paradigm of early AI, offering a simple and direct "if-this-then-that" approach. However, their limitations directly triggered the first AI winter, serving as the historical backdrop for machine learning eventually replacing symbolic AI.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as an AI built on if-then statements: transparent but hard to maintain, eventually hitting a brick wall.
terms.example_en:
· MYCIN used rules to diagnose blood infections, achieving higher accuracy than junior doctors.
· XCON configured VAX computers, saving tens of millions of dollars annually—but eventually required maintaining over 10,000 rules.
· The maintenance nightmare of rule-based systems directly triggered the first AI winter.
· Healthcare, legal, and financial compliance sectors still use rule-based systems today, as interpretability is often more important than raw accuracy.
examples_en: MYCIN used rules to diagnose blood infections, achieving higher accuracy than junior doctors.
XCON configured VAX computers, saving tens of millions of dollars annually.
The maintenance nightmare of rule-based systems directly triggered the first AI winter.

terms.definition_short: SAINT 是早期符号 AI 程序，能解决部分微积分积分问题。
terms.definition_short_en: SAINT is an early symbolic AI program developed in 1961 that was capable of solving specific symbolic integration problems in calculus.

terms.definition_short: SHRDLU 展示了机器在封闭小世界里理解语言并执行动作的可能。
terms.definition_short_en: SHRDLU demonstrated the possibility of a machine understanding language and executing actions within a small, closed world.

terms.definition_short: Sophia 是被推到聚光灯下的仿人社交机器人，代表 AI 公众想象和拟人化争议。
terms.definition_short_en: Sophia is a highly publicized humanoid social robot that symbolizes the public's imagination of AI and the controversies surrounding anthropomorphism.

terms.definition_short: Stanford Cart 是早期移动机器人平台，用视觉、控制和规划探索机器自主移动。
terms.definition_short_en: The Stanford Cart was an early mobile robot platform that explored autonomous machine movement through visual perception, control, and path planning.

terms.definition_short: Stored-Program Computer 让程序存进机器内存，机器可以按存储指令运行。
terms.definition_short_en: A stored-program computer stores its instructions in memory, allowing the machine to execute tasks based on these internally saved programs.

terms.definition_short: STUDENT 是早期自然语言程序，能把英文应用题转成代数方程求解。
terms.definition_short_en: STUDENT is an early natural language program capable of translating English word problems into algebraic equations and solving them.

terms.definition_short: Sunspring：2016 年第一部由 AI 编剧的短片——用 LSTM 模型 Benjamin 写的剧本——内容荒诞却出奇有诗意——AI 创意写作的起点。
terms.definition_short_en: Released in 2016, Sunspring is the first short film scripted entirely by an AI—an LSTM model named Benjamin—yielding an absurd yet surprisingly poetic narrative that pioneered AI creative writing.

terms.definition_short: Swarm AI 用多人实时协同形成群体判断，是人机协同和群体智能的一条旁支。
terms.definition_short_en: Swarm AI uses real-time collaboration among multiple participants to form collective judgments, representing a distinct branch of human-computer collaboration and swarm intelligence.

terms.definition_short: Symbolic AI 是早期 AI 主线，用符号、规则和搜索来模拟推理。
terms.definition_short_en: Symbolic AI was the dominant paradigm in early artificial intelligence, relying on symbols, rules, and search algorithms to simulate human reasoning.

terms.definition_short: TD-Gammon 是 1992 年用强化学习自我对弈学出来的西洋双陆棋程序，AlphaGo 的前传。
terms.definition_short_en: TD-Gammon is a 1992 backgammon program that achieved master-level play through reinforcement learning and self-play, serving as an early precursor to AlphaGo.

terms.definition_short: TD 学习：Temporal Difference——时间差学习——强化学习的根本思想——不是等到终局才发奖励——每走一步都用当前估计修正上一步估计。
terms.definition_short_en: Temporal Difference (TD) learning is a foundational concept in reinforcement learning where an agent updates its previous estimate using its current estimate at every step, rather than waiting for a final reward at the end of an episode.

terms.definition_short: 忒修斯是 1950 年 Claude Shannon 做的迷宫鼠，最早的机器学习硬件。
terms.definition_short_en: Theseus is a maze-solving mechanical mouse created by Claude Shannon in 1950, recognized as the earliest hardware implementation of machine learning.

terms.definition_short: AAAI 是人工智能领域的重要学术组织，像 AI 研究共同体的大会客厅。
terms.definition_short_en: AAAI is a major academic organization in the field of artificial intelligence, functioning as a central gathering place for the AI research community.

terms.definition_short: 李飞飞联合创立的非营利组织，推动向高中阶段女生、有色人种和经济弱势学生开放大学 AI 实验室。
terms.definition_short_en: A nonprofit organization co-founded by Fei-Fei Li that promotes opening university AI labs to high school girls, students of color, and economically disadvantaged students.

terms.definition_short: Alan Turing 把计算机器和机器智能问题接到一起，是 AI 前史里最值得关注的起点人物。
terms.definition_short_en: Alan Turing bridged the concepts of computing machines and machine intelligence, making him the most crucial foundational figure in the prehistory of artificial intelligence.
terms.back_en: A British mathematician who laid the foundation for computability theory and machine intelligence. He proposed the Turing Test in 1950, transforming the philosophical question of whether machines can think into an observable and testable problem.
terms.definition_long_en:
Turing's significance extends far beyond the Turing Test. In 1936, he clarified the concept of computation by proposing the Turing Machine. This formalized computability theory, laid the foundation for modern computer science, and formed the basis of the Church-Turing thesis. During World War II (1939–1945), he applied this abstract computing power to real-world challenges at Bletchley Park, where his team cracked the German Enigma code, shortening the war by an estimated two years.

More remarkably, Turing seriously investigated machine intelligence long before the field existed. In a 1948 internal report, *Intelligent Machinery*, he explored whether machines could improve their performance through training—an intuition closely resembling modern machine learning. In 1950, he published *Computing Machinery and Intelligence* in the journal *Mind*, introducing the Turing Test. By bypassing fruitless philosophical debates about whether machines possess souls, he asked a practical question: if a machine's behavior is indistinguishable from a human's, how should we evaluate its intelligence?

This shift was crucial. It transformed the question of whether machines can think from an abstract philosophical argument into an observable, testable, and debatable issue of performance.
terms.why_it_matters_en: He provided AI with its most fundamental conceptual framework. Today's debates surrounding large language models, chatbots, AI agents, and the Turing Test are essentially still trying to answer the core question he posed: when a machine behaves as if it is thinking, how should we understand its intelligence?
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember him as the pioneer who turned machine intelligence into a testable problem with the 1950 Turing Test.
terms.example_en:
· 1936: Proposed the Turing Machine, formalizing computability theory.
· 1939–1945: Cracked the Enigma code at Bletchley Park, shortening WWII by an estimated two years.
· 1950: Introduced the Turing Test, turning the question of whether machines can think into an observable performance issue.
· ACM A.M. Turing Award: The highest distinction in computer science is named in his honor.
examples_en: The Turing Test transformed the question of whether machines can think into a matter of observing a machine's conversational performance.
Many of the debates sparked by chatbots today are still rooted in the fundamental questions Turing left behind.

terms.term: 亚历克斯·克里热夫斯基
terms.term_zh: 亚历克斯·克里热夫斯基
terms.definition_short: AlexNet 的主要作者，2012 年用深度卷积神经网络碾压 ImageNet 竞赛，引爆了深度学习革命。
terms.definition_short_en: The lead author of AlexNet, who dominated the 2012 ImageNet competition using a deep convolutional neural network and ignited the deep learning revolution.
terms.displayName: 亚历克斯·克里热夫斯基

terms.definition_short: Allen Newell（1927-1992）是计算机科学家和认知心理学家。
terms.definition_short_en: Allen Newell (1927–1992) was a pioneering computer scientist and cognitive psychologist at Carnegie Mellon University.

terms.definition_short: AMD：跟英伟达在 GPU 市场竞争的第二名——有不错的硬件但被 CUDA 生态挡在 AI 赛道外面。
terms.definition_short_en: The runner-up to NVIDIA in the GPU market, featuring strong hardware but largely blocked from the AI race by the dominance of the CUDA software ecosystem.

terms.definition_short: Karpathy 是让 AI 圈自学入门的那个人——nanoGPT 作者、vibe coding 提出者。
