terms.definition_short: 苹果——IA 派的旗舰公司，用技术增强人类创造力。
terms.definition_short_en: Apple is the flagship company of the Intelligence Augmentation (IA) school, dedicated to using technology to augment human creativity.

terms.definition_short: LangSmith vs LangFuse：两个 LLM 应用可观测平台的对比——LangSmith 商业云端、LangFuse 开源自部署。
terms.definition_short_en: A comparison between two LLM observability platforms: LangSmith is a commercial cloud-based solution, while LangFuse is an open-source, self-hosted alternative.

terms.definition_short: 李世石是韩国围棋冠军，2016 年以 1:4 负于 AlphaGo，是 AI 公众史上的标志性对决。
terms.definition_short_en: Lee Sedol is a South Korean Go champion whose 1-4 loss to AlphaGo in 2016 stands as a landmark showdown in the public history of artificial intelligence.

terms.definition_short: 李飞飞是 ImageNet 的关键推动者，把「给 AI 足够大的数据考场」这件事推成现代视觉 AI 的地基。
terms.definition_short_en: Fei-Fei Li is the key driving force behind ImageNet, establishing the concept of providing AI with a massive data testing ground as the foundation of modern visual AI.
terms.front_en: Why is Fei-Fei Li so important to modern AI?
terms.back_en: Fei-Fei Li spearheaded ImageNet, providing visual AI with massive annotated data and a unified competitive arena. The subsequent breakthrough of AlexNet relied heavily on this data foundation.
terms.definition_long_en:
Who is Fei-Fei Li? She is the researcher who enabled machines to "see." Immigrating from China to the US at 15, she helped her working-class parents at a dry cleaner while studying at Princeton. Upon graduation, her mother encouraged her to decline lucrative Wall Street offers to pursue science. Later, while critically ill, her mother asked what else AI could do to help people. These moments shaped Li's dual paths as a scientist and a humanist.

Her most critical contribution was not an algorithm, but ImageNet. Conceptualized in 2007, it was built on the premise that vision is the first step toward machine intelligence and that data matters more than algorithms. ImageNet ultimately featured over 14 million annotated images, dwarfing existing datasets.

The 2012 breakthrough of AlexNet at the ImageNet competition marked the first perfect convergence of data (ImageNet), algorithms (CNN), and computing power (GPU). Without Fei-Fei Li, ImageNet would not exist, and without ImageNet, the AlexNet milestone would not have happened. Extending her humanist vision, she also founded AI4ALL to promote diversity in the AI field.
terms.why_it_matters_en: She transformed datasets from a supporting role into the main character. Understanding her work is key to understanding why ImageNet serves as the foundation for modern AI's takeoff, as well as the historic convergence of data, algorithms, and computing power behind AlexNet.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember her as the person who built the ultimate testing ground for machines to see the world.
terms.example_en:
· ImageNet was a bet—a bet that vision is the first step toward machine intelligence, and that data is more important than algorithms.
· The breakthrough of AlexNet at the 2012 ImageNet competition marked the first perfect convergence of data, algorithms, and computing power.
· She founded AI4ALL to promote the inclusion of women and minority groups in the AI field.
· In 2018, she advocated for "Human-Centered AI" before Congress while her mother was critically ill recovering from surgery.
examples_en: ImageNet was a bet—a bet that vision is the first step toward machine intelligence, and that data is more important than algorithms.
The breakthrough of AlexNet at the 2012 ImageNet competition marked the first perfect convergence of three elements: data (ImageNet), algorithms (CNN), and computing power (GPU).
She founded AI4ALL to promote the inclusion of women and minority groups in the AI field.
In 2018, she advocated for "Human-Centered AI" before Congress while her mother was critically ill recovering from surgery.

terms.definition_short: 梁文锋是 DeepSeek 创始人，把量化工程里的效率意识带进中国大模型竞争。
terms.definition_short_en: Liang Wenfeng is the founder of DeepSeek, known for bringing the efficiency-driven mindset of quantitative engineering into the Chinese foundation model competition.
terms.front_en: Why does Liang Wenfeng represent the DeepSeek approach?
terms.back_en: Liang Wenfeng brought the efficiency mindset of quantitative engineering into foundation model R&D. He drove DeepSeek's global competitiveness through open weights, technical reports, and low-cost inference—training DeepSeek-V3 for $5.6 million and making reasoning models open with DeepSeek-R1.
terms.definition_long_en:
Liang Wenfeng's core philosophy can be summarized in one word: efficiency.

His early career in quantitative investment at High-Flyer involved long-term optimization of algorithms, data, compute, and engineering systems. When he later founded DeepSeek, he brought this background into foundation model R&D, emphasizing training efficiency, inference costs, detailed technical reports, open weights, and engineering precision.

This approach yielded DeepSeek-V3 (2024), a model with 671B total parameters and 37B active parameters, trained for approximately $5.6 million—significantly lower than comparable models. In January 2025, DeepSeek-R1 was released, utilizing reinforcement learning and cold-start data to train a reasoning model. By releasing open weights, it shifted reasoning model training methods from an OpenAI black box to public knowledge.

DeepSeek-V3 and DeepSeek-R1 demonstrated that Chinese teams could build competitive models with more restrained resources. The impact goes beyond model rankings, sparking a global debate: do frontier models strictly require the most expensive, compute-heavy approaches, or can engineering efficiency, open strategies, and lower inference costs rewrite the competitive landscape?
terms.why_it_matters_en: He introduced a highly distinct paradigm to the Chinese foundation model competition: challenging the high-cost narrative with engineering efficiency and open strategies. Understanding his approach is key to understanding why DeepSeek suddenly became a central player in global AI discussions.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember him as the founder who brought quantitative engineering efficiency to foundation models: $5.6M DeepSeek-V3 and open-weight DeepSeek-R1.
terms.example_en:
· Early career in quantitative investment (High-Flyer), bringing an efficiency mindset to foundation model R&D.
· DeepSeek-V3 (2024): 671B total parameters, 37B active parameters, $5.6 million training cost.
· DeepSeek-R1 (Jan 2025): Made reasoning models, open weights, and low-cost APIs a focal point of global discussion.
examples_en: DeepSeek-R1 made reasoning models, open weights, and low-cost APIs a focal point of global discussion.

terms.definition_short: Lotfi Zadeh 提出 Fuzzy Sets，让机器能处理「有点热」「比较危险」这类带程度的判断。
terms.definition_short_en: Lotfi Zadeh introduced Fuzzy Sets, enabling machines to process nuanced, degree-based judgments like 'a bit hot' or 'quite dangerous' instead of relying solely on rigid binary logic.

terms.definition_short: Magic.dev——2024 年拿到 3.2 亿美元融资的 AI 编程公司——在做能理解百万行代码库的 AI 编程助手。
terms.definition_short_en: Magic.dev is an AI coding startup that raised $320 million in 2024. It is developing an AI coding assistant designed to understand codebases containing millions of lines of code.

terms.definition_short: Marvin Minsky 是 MIT 早期 AI 雄心的代表人物，把机器推理、知识表示和智能机制推到研究中心。
terms.definition_short_en: Marvin Minsky was a central figure in MIT's early AI ambitions, bringing machine reasoning, knowledge representation, and mechanisms of intelligence to the forefront of academic research.

terms.definition_short: 元学习——让模型学会如何学习——不是学会具体任务，是学会在面对新任务时能快速适应。
terms.definition_short_en: Meta-learning trains a model on how to learn. Instead of mastering a single specific task, the model learns to quickly adapt when faced with entirely new tasks.

terms.definition_short: 元提示——用 LLM 改写和优化你的原始提示词——让 AI 帮你写更好的 prompt。
terms.definition_short_en: Meta-prompting is the practice of using an LLM to rewrite and optimize your original prompt, essentially having the AI help you write a better one.

terms.definition_short: 元数据存储——管理 ML 实验的非模型数据——超参、评估指标、数据版本、模型来源。MLflow 和 W&B 都是元数据存储。
terms.definition_short_en: A metadata store manages the non-model data of machine learning experiments, including hyperparameters, evaluation metrics, data versions, and model lineage. Tools like MLflow and W&B serve as metadata stores.

terms.definition_short: Mistral AI——法国开源大模型公司，2023 年成立，用 MoE 架构 + 开源策略成了欧洲 AI 标杆。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2023, Mistral AI is a French AI startup that established itself as a European benchmark by leveraging a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture and an open-weight strategy.

terms.definition_short: MIT——麻省理工学院，1861 年创办，AI 研究的全球重镇。
terms.definition_short_en: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), founded in 1861, is a premier global hub for artificial intelligence research.

terms.definition_short: Norbert Wiener 奠定控制论，把机器、动物、通信和反馈放进同一套框架。
terms.definition_short_en: Norbert Wiener was the founder of cybernetics, establishing a unified theoretical framework to study communication, control, and feedback in both machines and animals.

terms.definition_short: CUDA 生态——英伟达的护城河不是 GPU 硬件——是 CUDA 生态。
terms.definition_short_en: NVIDIA's true moat is not its GPU hardware, but the CUDA ecosystem—a comprehensive software stack that dominates AI development.

terms.definition_short: 李飞飞的学生，ImageNet 竞赛后期的组织者，AI 公平性和透明度研究的重要推动者。
terms.definition_short_en: A student of Fei-Fei Li who organized the later years of the ImageNet competition and became a key advocate for AI fairness and transparency research.

terms.definition_short: OpenAI 是创建 ChatGPT、GPT、Codex、Sora 等产品和模型的 AI 公司。
terms.definition_short_en: OpenAI is the AI company responsible for creating foundational models and products such as ChatGPT, the GPT series, Codex, and Sora.

terms.definition_short: OpenAI API——GPT-4 GPT-3.5 DALL-E Whisper 的云 API——几行代码接入最强大的 AI 能力。
terms.definition_short_en: The OpenAI API is a cloud-based interface for models like GPT-4, GPT-3.5, DALL-E, and Whisper, allowing developers to integrate powerful AI capabilities with just a few lines of code.

terms.definition_short: OpenBayes 是中国较早一批专注 AI 算力云与机器学习基础设施的平台，面向科研与工业场景提供全流程 AI 开发能力。
terms.definition_short_en: OpenBayes is one of China's early platforms focusing on AI computing clouds and machine learning infrastructure, providing end-to-end AI development capabilities for scientific research and industrial applications.

terms.definition_short: 加州理工学院教授，李飞飞的博士生导师。他带着李飞飞从单样本学习一路做到 Caltech 101，奠定了她的研究方向。
terms.definition_short_en: A Caltech professor and Fei-Fei Li's PhD advisor. He guided her from one-shot learning all the way to the creation of Caltech 101, laying the foundation for her research direction.

terms.definition_short: 雷·库兹韦尔——发明家、未来学家——奇点理论的最著名倡导者。
terms.definition_short_en: Ray Kurzweil is an American inventor and futurist, best known as the most prominent advocate of the technological singularity theory.

terms.definition_short: MIT 教授，行为机器人学创始人，iRobot 创始人。
terms.definition_short_en: An MIT professor, the pioneer of behavior-based robotics, and the co-founder of iRobot, known for creating the Roomba vacuum.

terms.definition_short: Sam Altman 是把 OpenAI 的模型能力推向大众产品、开发者平台和产业叙事的公司组织者。
terms.definition_short_en: Sam Altman is the executive who translated OpenAI's model capabilities into mass-market products, developer platforms, and broader industry narratives.
terms.front_en: Why is Sam Altman the face of OpenAI's productization strategy?
terms.back_en: Sam Altman pushed OpenAI's research capabilities into product lines like ChatGPT, GPT, Codex, and Sora, bringing foundation models out of the lab and onto platforms for everyday users and developers.
terms.definition_long_en:
Altman's primary focus has been transforming AI model capabilities into major societal events.

In its early days, OpenAI was driven by research ideals and a safety vision. With the launch of ChatGPT, large language models were used daily by the general public for the first time. Altman's role has been to orchestrate research, product development, platforms, capital, computing power, and public narratives, turning OpenAI from a research lab into a primary access point for the foundation model era.

This strategy later expanded to include products and platform capabilities like GPT, Codex, Sora, Operator, and Deep Research. Each product line addresses the same core question: how can powerful models be integrated into everyday workflows, developer ecosystems, and enterprise systems?

Previously, Altman served as the president of Y Combinator (2014-2019), an experience that provided him with a deep understanding of the startup ecosystem and productization.
terms.why_it_matters_en: He represents the drive to productize and platformize foundation models. Following ChatGPT, AI competition hinges not only on raw model capabilities but also on who can successfully transform these models into access points, ecosystems, commercial systems, and compelling public narratives.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember him as the executive who pushed foundation models to mass-market access points and developer platforms: former Y Combinator president and current OpenAI CEO.
terms.example_en:
· ChatGPT allowed everyday users to directly experience the usability of large language models for the first time.
· Codex and developer platforms integrated model capabilities into software engineering workflows.
· Served as president of Y Combinator from 2014 to 2019.
examples_en: ChatGPT allowed everyday users to directly experience the usability of large language models for the first time.
Codex and developer platforms integrated model capabilities into software engineering workflows.

terms.definition_short: Sepp Hochreiter 和 Jürgen Schmidhuber——1997 年发明 LSTM——深度学习隐形的最大贡献者。
terms.definition_short_en: Sepp Hochreiter and Jürgen Schmidhuber are the inventors of LSTM (1997) and stand as some of the most significant, yet often overlooked, contributors to deep learning.

terms.definition_short: 林奈马——1970 年提出反向模式自动微分，是反向传播和深度学习训练的数学基础。
terms.definition_short_en: Seppo Linnainmaa proposed reverse mode automatic differentiation in 1970, providing the mathematical foundation for backpropagation and deep learning training.

terms.definition_short: Seymour Papert 是 AI、教育计算和建构主义学习的重要人物。
terms.definition_short_en: Seymour Papert was a pioneering figure in artificial intelligence, educational computing, and constructionist learning.

terms.definition_short: Shunichi Amari 连接早期神经网络训练、学习理论和信息几何。
terms.definition_short_en: Shunichi Amari is a foundational figure who connects early neural network training, learning theory, and information geometry.

terms.definition_short: Terry Winograd 是早期自然语言理解和人机交互领域的重要人物，SHRDLU 作者。
terms.definition_short_en: Terry Winograd is a pioneering figure in early natural language understanding and human-computer interaction, best known as the creator of the SHRDLU system.

terms.definition_short: 李飞飞的学生，AI 伦理和算法偏见领域的先驱。她主导了谷歌街景汽车与人口普查数据的关联研究。
terms.definition_short_en: A student of Fei-Fei Li and a pioneer in AI ethics and algorithmic bias, known for her research correlating Google Street View cars with demographic data.

terms.definition_short: Valve——CS Dota Half-Life 和 Steam 的创造者——一个不上市没有管理层的扁平结构公司。
terms.definition_short_en: Valve is the creator of Half-Life, Counter-Strike, Dota 2, and Steam, operating as a highly profitable, privately held company with a radically flat structure and no traditional management.

terms.definition_short: Walter Pitts 把神经元拉进逻辑世界，和 McCulloch 一起提出早期人工神经元模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Walter Pitts brought biological neurons into the realm of logic, co-authoring an early formalized model of artificial neurons alongside Warren McCulloch.

terms.definition_short: Warren McCulloch 把神经活动、逻辑和计算连接起来，是连接主义前史的关键人物。
terms.definition_short_en: Warren McCulloch linked neural activity, logic, and computation, making him a key figure in the prehistory of connectionism.

terms.definition_short: Yann LeCun 是让卷积神经网络真正进入视觉应用的人，也是现代计算机视觉路线的关键奠基者。
terms.definition_short_en: Yann LeCun is the pioneer who brought convolutional neural networks into practical visual applications and a key founding figure of modern computer vision.

terms.definition_short: Yoshua Bengio 是深度学习复兴的根本人物，长期研究模型怎样从数据里学出有用表示。
terms.definition_short_en: Yoshua Bengio is a foundational figure in the deep learning revolution, best known for his pioneering research on how models can automatically learn useful representations from data.
terms.front_en: Why is Yoshua Bengio so important to deep learning?
terms.back_en: Yoshua Bengio pioneered representation learning and neural networks, enabling models to automatically extract useful features from data—a core foundation of modern deep learning. He shared the 2018 Turing Award with Geoffrey Hinton and Yann LeCun.
terms.definition_long_en:
Bengio's primary research focus can be summarized by a single question: how can models learn to "understand" data on their own?

Traditional machine learning often relied on hand-crafted features, where humans explicitly told the machine which clues to look for before it made a judgment. Bengio has long championed representation learning, which aims to enable models to automatically extract useful features from data, such as word relationships, image structures, semantic spaces, and patterns in time series.

This approach ultimately became the foundation of modern deep learning. The ability of large language models to process language, analyze images, and perform reasoning relies heavily on representation learning: models compress the complex world into computable internal representations, which are then used to execute tasks.

Bengio is a professor at the University of Montreal and the founder of Mila (Montreal Institute for Learning Algorithms), one of the world's largest academic AI research centers.
terms.why_it_matters_en: He established the concept of models automatically learning features as a fundamental pillar of modern AI. Understanding his work reveals deep learning as a pathway for machines to develop internal representations of the world, demonstrating that scaling up model size is only one part of the equation.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember him as the pioneer of representation learning and "internal understanding"—Mila founder and 2018 Turing Laureate.
terms.example_en:
· Word vectors, latent spaces, and multi-layer representations can all be understood through the lens of "how models organize the world."
· Founded Mila at the University of Montreal, one of the world's largest academic AI research institutes.
examples_en: Word vectors, latent spaces, and multi-layer representations can all be understood through the lens of "how models organize the world."

terms.definition_short: 利克莱德（J.C.R. Licklider）——人机共生理论提出者，AI 和 IA 的共同资助人。
terms.definition_short_en: J.C.R. Licklider was the originator of the "Man-Computer Symbiosis" theory and a key early funder of both Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Intelligence Amplification (IA) research.

terms.definition_short: 埃德·费根鲍姆（Ed Feigenbaum）——专家系统之父，知识工程奠基人。
terms.definition_short_en: Ed Feigenbaum is widely recognized as the father of expert systems and the founder of knowledge engineering.

terms.definition_short: 塞巴斯蒂安·特龙（Sebastian Thrun）——Google 无人车创始人，SLAM 技术先驱，Udacity 联合创始人。
terms.definition_short_en: Sebastian Thrun is the founder of Google's self-driving car project, a pioneer in SLAM technology, and the co-founder of Udacity.

terms.definition_short: 雷·库兹韦尔（Ray Kurzweil）——奇点论倡导者，未来学家，发明家。
terms.definition_short_en: Ray Kurzweil is a prominent futurist, inventor, and the leading advocate of the technological singularity.

terms.definition_short: 道格拉斯·恩格尔巴特（Douglas Engelbart）——鼠标发明者，IA 派精神领袖。
terms.definition_short_en: Douglas Engelbart was the inventor of the computer mouse and the spiritual leader of the Intelligence Augmentation (IA) movement.

terms.definition_short: 马文·明斯基（Marvin Minsky）——MIT AI 实验室创始人，GOFAI 倡导者。
terms.definition_short_en: Marvin Minsky was the founder of the MIT AI Lab and a prominent advocate of GOFAI (Good Old-Fashioned AI).

terms.definition_short: 比尔·杜瓦尔（Bill Duvall）——跨 AI 和 IA 两派的第一人，互联网诞生的参与者。
terms.definition_short_en: Bill Duvall is the first person to bridge the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Intelligence Amplification (IA) camps, and a key participant in the birth of the internet.

terms.definition_short: 汉斯·莫拉维克（Hans Moravec）——AI 极端乐观主义者，机器取代人类预言者。
terms.definition_short_en: Hans Moravec is an extreme AI optimist and futurist known for predicting that machines will eventually surpass humans and replace all human labor.

terms.definition_short: 约翰·塞尔（John Searle）——中文屋思想实验提出者，强 AI 批判者。
terms.definition_short_en: John Searle is the creator of the Chinese Room thought experiment and a prominent critic of strong AI.

terms.definition_short: 艾伦·凯（Alan Kay）——Dynabook 构想者，个人计算先知，Smalltalk 发明者之一。
terms.definition_short_en: Alan Kay is the visionary behind the Dynabook concept, a pioneer of personal computing, and one of the inventors of the Smalltalk programming language.

terms.definition_short: Accountability 是明确当 AI 系统出问题时，谁负责、怎么追溯、如何补救。
terms.definition_short_en: Accountability is the principle of defining who is responsible, how to trace the root cause, and how to provide remedies when an AI system fails or causes harm.

terms.definition_short: AI 与就业讨论自动化如何改变职业结构：哪些岗位受影响、哪些新工作被创造、人需要怎样适应。
terms.definition_short_en: The discussion around AI and employment explores how automation reshapes occupational structures, which jobs are affected, what new roles are created, and how humans must adapt.

terms.definition_short: AI Fairness 关注模型是否对不同性别、种族、年龄的群体产生偏差对待，确保机会分配不因模型出现新歧视。
terms.definition_short_en: AI Fairness examines whether models exhibit biased treatment toward different gender, racial, or age groups, ensuring that the distribution of opportunities does not create new forms of discrimination.

terms.definition_short: AI for Good 是把 AI 技术用于解决社会和环境问题——医疗、气候、教育、防灾、贫困等公共领域。
terms.definition_short_en: AI for Good is the application of AI technology to solve social and environmental problems across public sectors, including healthcare, climate change, education, disaster prevention, and poverty alleviation.

terms.definition_short: AI Red Teaming 是请安全专家扮演攻击者，主动测试模型的安全漏洞和不良行为极限。
terms.definition_short_en: AI Red Teaming involves security experts acting as attackers to proactively test a model for security vulnerabilities and the limits of its harmful behaviors.

terms.definition_short: AI Safety 研究如何确保 AI 系统按预期运作，不造成意外伤害。核心包括对齐（Alignment）、鲁棒性（Robustness）、可解释性（Interpretability）。
terms.definition_short_en: AI safety research explores how to ensure AI systems operate as intended without causing unintended harm, focusing on three core areas: alignment, robustness, and interpretability.
terms.back_en: AI safety research focuses on ensuring AI systems operate as intended without causing unintended harm. Its three core directions are alignment, robustness, and interpretability.
terms.definition_long_en:
AI safety research focuses on ensuring AI systems operate as intended without causing unintended harm, primarily through alignment, robustness, and interpretability.
In 2019, the release of GPT-2 was delayed due to safety concerns—marking the first time AI safety directly impacted a product's release cadence. OpenAI deemed GPT-2 too powerful at the time, fearing it might be misused to generate fake news or deceptive content, and opted for a staged release of smaller versions to observe their impact.
In 2023, the GPT-4 System Card publicly detailed model safety evaluations for the first time—including red teaming results, potential risk assessments, and mitigation measures—serving as a milestone in AI safety transparency.
The three core directions of AI safety are:
· Alignment: Ensuring the model's intentions align with human values, preventing it from doing what humans do not want.
· Robustness: Keeping the model stable when facing adversarial examples or out-of-distribution data, ensuring it is not easily fooled by minor perturbations.
· Interpretability: Allowing humans to understand why a model makes a specific decision, moving away from a black-box approach.
Additionally, the Asilomar AI Principles, proposed in 2017 with 23 guidelines, serve as an ethical cornerstone for the field.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Safety is not optional. From the delayed release of GPT-2 and the Asilomar Principles to the EU AI Act, every development in this field directly impacts the AI products you use daily.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as preventing AI from causing unintended harm, marked by milestones like the 2019 GPT-2 delay, the 2023 GPT-4 System Card, and the Asilomar Principles.
terms.example_en:
· The release of GPT-2 was delayed due to safety concerns, marking the first time AI safety impacted a product launch.
· The Asilomar AI Principles proposed 23 guidelines for AI safety.
· The EU AI Act introduced regulatory requirements for high-risk AI systems.
· The GPT-4 System Card publicly detailed model safety evaluations for the first time.
examples_en: The release of GPT-2 was delayed due to safety concerns, marking the first time AI safety impacted a product launch.
The Asilomar AI Principles proposed 23 guidelines for AI safety.
The EU AI Act introduced regulatory requirements for high-risk AI systems.

terms.definition_short: Algorithmic Transparency 要求 AI 系统的决策过程和依据能被理解、审查和解释，而不是黑箱操作。
terms.definition_short_en: Algorithmic transparency is the principle requiring that an AI system's decision-making processes and rationale can be understood, audited, and explained, rather than functioning as a black box.

terms.definition_short: Informed Consent 要求 AI 系统在使用用户数据之前，清楚告知数据怎么用、用来干什么、用户如何撤销同意。
terms.definition_short_en: Informed consent requires AI systems to clearly explain how user data will be used, for what purpose, and how consent can be revoked before any data is processed.

terms.definition_short: Responsible AI 是一套原则和实践框架，确保 AI 系统在公平、透明、安全、隐私、问责五个维度都经得起检验。
terms.definition_short_en: Responsible AI is a framework of principles and practices ensuring that AI systems stand up to scrutiny across five key dimensions: fairness, transparency, safety, privacy, and accountability.

terms.definition_short: 收购是大型科技公司通过买下创业公司快速获取 AI 人才、技术和数据的商业动作。
terms.definition_short_en: An acquisition is a strategic business move where large tech companies buy startups to rapidly secure AI talent, technology, and data.

terms.definition_short: AI 商业化是 AI 技术转化为商业价值的路径——包括 API 计费、产品订阅、硬件销售三种主要模式。
terms.definition_short_en: AI commercialization is the process of translating AI technology into commercial value, primarily driven by three core business models: API billing, product subscriptions, and hardware sales.
terms.front_en: How do AI companies actually make money?
terms.back_en: AI commercialization follows three main paths: API token billing, product subscriptions, and hardware sales. Each approach has distinct business models and representative companies.
terms.definition_long_en:
AI commercialization follows three primary paths: API token billing, product subscriptions, and hardware sales.

Historically, every technological breakthrough is followed by a wave of commercialization. While expert systems attempted and failed to commercialize in the 1980s, the commercialization of deep learning only truly took off in the 2020s.

The three paths are defined by distinct models:
· API token billing: Developers pay based on usage. For example, OpenAI charges by token volume, with the GPT-4 API historically costing around $0.03 per 1K input tokens and $0.06 per 1K output tokens.
· Product subscriptions: Companies charge recurring fees for premium access. OpenAI offers ChatGPT Plus to consumers for $20/month, while GitHub Copilot charges per seat, such as $39/month for its enterprise tier.
· Hardware sales: Companies sell the foundational computing power for AI training and inference. NVIDIA's H100 GPUs, priced around $30,000, have faced massive demand shortages.

These paths are not mutually exclusive. OpenAI offers both APIs and consumer subscriptions, Google develops TPU hardware alongside its Gemini API, and NVIDIA sells chips while maintaining its CUDA software ecosystem.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Understanding commercialization is key to grasping the survival logic of AI companies. Whether selling tokens via APIs, products via subscriptions, or chips via hardware sales, each path dictates a fundamentally different business strategy.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as AI's three money-making paths: API tokens (OpenAI), subscriptions (GitHub), and hardware (NVIDIA).
terms.example_en:
· OpenAI's ChatGPT Plus subscription at $20/month.
· NVIDIA H100 GPUs priced around $30,000 and in high demand.
· GitHub Copilot charging per seat, with the enterprise tier at $39/month.
· GPT-4 API billing by token usage—$0.03/1K input tokens and $0.06/1K output tokens.
examples_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT Plus subscription at $20/month.
NVIDIA H100 GPUs priced around $30,000 and in high demand.
GitHub Copilot charging per seat, with the enterprise tier at $39/month.

terms.definition_short: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 的编程 Agent 产品，把 Claude 接入真实代码仓库和软件工程工作流。
terms.definition_short_en: Claude Code is Anthropic's coding agent that integrates Claude directly into real-world code repositories and software engineering workflows.

terms.definition_short: 编程智能体不只是补全代码，而是能在仓库里推进一件编程任务。
terms.definition_short_en: A coding agent goes beyond simple code completion; it can actively execute and advance programming tasks within a repository.

terms.definition_short: Augmentation 是把 AI 当成能力放大器，让人做得更快、更准或覆盖更多信息。
terms.definition_short_en: Augmentation treats AI as a capability amplifier, enabling humans to work faster, more accurately, or process larger volumes of information.

terms.definition_short: Automation 是让系统按规则或模型输出自动执行任务，减少人工逐步操作。
terms.definition_short_en: Automation is the process of having a system execute tasks automatically based on rules or model outputs, reducing the need for step-by-step human intervention.

terms.definition_short: AI Literacy 是让人知道 AI 能做什么、不能做什么，以及如何负责任地使用它。
terms.definition_short_en: AI literacy is the foundational knowledge of what AI can and cannot do, along with the ability to use it responsibly.

terms.definition_short: AI Tutor 是面向学习过程的 AI 导师，负责讲解、提问、反馈和陪练。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI Tutor is a learning-oriented AI assistant designed to explain concepts, ask questions, provide feedback, and act as a practice partner.

terms.definition_short: AI Companion 是更像陪伴对象的聊天 AI，重点是持续互动、情绪反馈和关系感。
terms.definition_short_en: An AI Companion is a conversational AI designed to act as a companion, focusing on sustained interaction, emotional feedback, and a sense of relationship.

terms.definition_short: Copyright 是版权制度，AI 时代的核心争议在于训练、生成和使用结果如何承担权利责任。
terms.definition_short_en: Copyright is a legal framework protecting original works; in the AI era, its core controversies revolve around the allocation of rights and liabilities regarding training data, generation, and output usage.

terms.definition_short: Midjourney 是大众最熟悉的 AI 图像生成工具之一，擅长高质感、强风格化视觉输出。
terms.definition_short_en: Midjourney is one of the most widely recognized AI image generation tools, known for producing high-quality, strongly stylized visual outputs.

terms.term: Stable Diffusion 图像生成模型
terms.term_zh: Stable Diffusion 图像生成模型
terms.definition_short: Stable Diffusion 是代表性的开放权重图像生成模型，推动了 AI 图像创作的社区生态。
terms.definition_short_en: Stable Diffusion is a representative open-weight image generation model that has driven the community ecosystem for AI image creation.
terms.displayName: Stable Diffusion 图像生成模型
terms.back_en: Stable Diffusion is a representative open-weight image generation model, bringing text-to-image capabilities into local deployment, community fine-tuning, and plugin ecosystems.
terms.definition_long_en:
The significance of Stable Diffusion lies in its openness and adaptability. Compared to image models restricted to closed products, it allows developers and creators to run it locally, fine-tune models, train custom styles, integrate plugins, and build workflows.

Built on the diffusion model architecture, it enables users to control generation results through prompts, sampling parameters, ControlNet, and LoRA. A massive ecosystem of models, workflows, and tools has formed around it within the community.

However, it also complicates issues regarding copyright, safety, model weight licensing, and abuse governance, as these capabilities are no longer controlled by a single platform.
terms.why_it_matters_en: Stable Diffusion is a critical milestone in the open-source AI creation ecosystem. It demonstrates how releasing open model weights can fundamentally transform creative tools and shift the balance of industry control.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as a community-modifiable text-to-image engine powered by open weights, ControlNet, and LoRA.
terms.example_en:
· Allows developers and creators to run locally, fine-tune models, train styles, integrate plugins, and build workflows.
  · Users control generation results through prompts, sampling parameters, ControlNet, and LoRA.
  · Complicates copyright, safety, model weight licensing, and abuse governance.
examples_en: In 2022, Stability AI open-sourced Stable Diffusion—generating images in seconds, requiring only an RTX 3060.
Latent Diffusion: Compresses data into a lower-dimensional space before diffusion—making it runnable on consumer-grade GPUs.
DALL-E charges for API access, Midjourney requires a monthly subscription, while SD runs locally—igniting an open-source ecosystem.
ControlNet precisely controls composition, while LoRA trains only a small subset of parameters for custom styles.
Install ComfyUI, download models from Civitai—and use prompts covering "subject, action, environment, style, and lighting."

terms.definition_short: 文生图就是用文字提示生成图片，是生成式 AI 最直观的能力之一。
terms.definition_short_en: Text-to-Image generates pictures from text prompts, serving as one of the most intuitive applications of generative AI.

terms.definition_short: 人工神经元是神经网络里的最小计算单元。
terms.definition_short_en: An artificial neuron is the smallest computational unit in a neural network.

terms.definition_short: 跳棋程序让人们看到程序可以从经验中变强。
terms.definition_short_en: Samuel's checkers program demonstrated that a computer program could improve its performance and grow stronger through experience.

terms.definition_short: 控制论是 AI 之前的重要前史，关心系统怎样根据反馈调整行为。
terms.definition_short_en: An important precursor to AI, cybernetics focuses on how systems adjust their behavior based on feedback.

terms.definition_short: 它让机器在规则游戏里「想几步以后」。
terms.definition_short_en: It is a foundational technique that allows machines to "think several steps ahead" when playing rule-based games.

terms.definition_short: 它把「机器会不会思考」换成了一个可观察的对话判断问题。
terms.definition_short_en: It replaces the abstract question of whether machines can think with an observable, behavior-based test of conversational ability.
terms.back_en: The Turing Test evaluates machine intelligence by asking whether a human evaluator can distinguish a machine from a human through text-based conversation.
terms.definition_long_en:
Rather than getting bogged down in defining the word "think," Alan Turing proposed the "imitation game": if a human evaluator cannot reliably distinguish a machine from a human through text-based conversation, how should we view machine intelligence?
　While it is no longer the sole benchmark for evaluating AI today—nor does it prove that a machine possesses true consciousness—it remains historically significant. It successfully transformed an abstract philosophical debate into a measurable test of behavioral performance.
　Today, the Turing Test is still frequently referenced in discussions surrounding chatbots, anthropomorphism, and AI evaluation.
terms.why_it_matters_en: As one of the most famous foundational concepts in AI history, it serves as a constant reminder to distinguish between merely "acting intelligent" and possessing true understanding.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as: the imitation game testing if conversational behavior makes a machine indistinguishable from a human (1950, "Computing Machinery and Intelligence").
terms.example_en:
· If a human cannot reliably distinguish a machine from a human through text-based conversation, how should we view machine intelligence?
　· It transformed an abstract philosophical question into a measurable test of behavioral performance.
　· Today, the Turing Test is still frequently referenced in discussions surrounding chatbots, anthropomorphism, and AI evaluation.
examples_en: Turing proposed the test in 1950, six years before the term 'artificial intelligence' was even coined.
In 1965, ELIZA used simple rule-matching to engage users in surprisingly long conversations.
During the first Turing Test competition in 1991, a machine successfully fooled human judges.

terms.definition_short: Agentic AI 是带有目标、工具调用和多步行动能力的 AI 工作方式。
terms.definition_short_en: Agentic AI is an AI paradigm characterized by goal-orientation, tool use, and the capacity for multi-step actions.

terms.definition_short: Autonomous Agent 是拥有目标、行动循环和一定自主性的 AI 系统。
terms.definition_short_en: An autonomous agent is an AI system equipped with specific goals, an action loop, and a degree of autonomy.

terms.definition_short: Agent Ops 是让 AI Agent 可观察、可评测、可回滚、可治理的一整套运维方法。
terms.definition_short_en: Agent Ops is a comprehensive set of operational practices designed to make AI agents observable, evaluable, reversible, and governable.

terms.definition_short: Browser Use 是让 AI 像用户一样操作网页，用浏览器完成搜索、填写和信息整理。
terms.definition_short_en: Browser Use enables AI to interact with web pages like a human user, utilizing a browser to perform searches, fill out forms, and organize information.

terms.definition_short: Google Brain 是 Google 深度学习研究的重要源头，后来与 DeepMind 合并为 Google DeepMind。
terms.definition_short_en: Google Brain was a foundational deep learning research team at Google that later merged with DeepMind to form Google DeepMind.

terms.definition_short: Meta AI 是 Meta 的 AI 研究与产品体系，尤其以 Llama 开放权重模型影响开源生态。
terms.definition_short_en: Meta AI is Meta's AI research and product division, significantly shaping the open ecosystem through its Llama open-weight models.

terms.definition_short: xAI 是围绕 Grok 模型和 X 生态展开的前沿 AI 公司。
terms.definition_short_en: xAI is a frontier AI company built around the Grok model and the X platform ecosystem.

terms.definition_short: AI 泡沫是对 AI 投资热潮和估值过高的风险判断。
terms.definition_short_en: The AI bubble refers to the risk assessment that the current surge in AI investments and company valuations may be unsustainably high.

terms.definition_short: Moat 是让竞争对手难以复制的长期优势。
terms.definition_short_en: A moat is a long-term competitive advantage that makes it difficult for rivals to replicate a company's success.

terms.definition_short: Jailbreak 是试图绕过 AI 安全边界的提示或交互策略。
terms.definition_short_en: A jailbreak is a prompt or interaction strategy that attempts to bypass an AI model's safety guardrails.

terms.definition_short: License 决定 AI 模型、数据和工具能不能商用、改造、再发布。
terms.definition_short_en: A license determines whether AI models, data, and tools can be legally commercialized, modified, or redistributed.

terms.definition_short: Model Card 是模型的说明卡，帮助用户理解它适合什么、不适合什么、风险在哪里。
terms.definition_short_en: A Model Card is an explanatory document for an AI model, helping users understand what it is suitable for, what it is not, and where its risks lie.

terms.definition_short: Agentic RAG 是会规划检索步骤、调用工具并迭代补查的 RAG 形态。
terms.definition_short_en: Agentic RAG is an advanced form of RAG that plans retrieval steps, uses tools, and iteratively conducts follow-up searches to gather missing information.

terms.definition_short: 切块决定 AI 从长资料里拿到的是完整线索，还是一堆断开的碎片。
terms.definition_short_en: Chunking determines whether an AI extracts complete, coherent clues from a long document or just a pile of disconnected fragments.

terms.definition_short: Citation 是 AI 回答里的来源标注，用来说明某个说法来自哪里。
terms.definition_short_en: A citation is a source annotation in an AI response that indicates where a specific claim or piece of information comes from.

terms.definition_short: Grounding 是让 AI 的回答有资料依据，而不是只靠模型记忆。
terms.definition_short_en: Grounding ensures that an AI's responses are based on factual data rather than relying solely on the model's internal memory.

terms.definition_short: Hybrid Search 同时看关键词匹配和语义相似度，让 RAG 检索更稳。
terms.definition_short_en: Hybrid Search evaluates both keyword matching and semantic similarity simultaneously, making RAG retrieval more robust.

terms.definition_short: Reranker 是检索后的二次筛选器，把更相关的结果排到前面。
terms.definition_short_en: A Reranker acts as a secondary filter after the initial retrieval, pushing the most relevant results to the top of the list.

terms.definition_short: 基准污染是模型提前见过考题，评测分数因此不可靠。
terms.definition_short_en: Benchmark contamination happens when an AI model has already seen the test questions during training, making its evaluation scores unreliable.

terms.definition_short: Evals 是给 AI 系统做测试集、评分标准和回归检查。
terms.definition_short_en: Evals involve creating test sets, scoring rubrics, and regression checks to systematically assess AI systems.

terms.definition_short: 它是一座给视觉模型训练和比赛用的数据山。
terms.definition_short_en: It is a massive repository of annotated images used to train vision models and benchmark their performance in competitions.

terms.definition_short: Shakey 是早期把感知、推理、规划和行动放到同一机器人里的代表。
terms.definition_short_en: Shakey is a pioneering early robot that integrated perception, reasoning, planning, and action into a single physical system.

terms.definition_short: AI 是一大类让机器表现出智能行为的方法、系统和产品。
terms.definition_short_en: AI is a broad category of methods, systems, and products designed to make machines exhibit intelligent behavior.

terms.definition_short: 人工智能不是单一技术，而是一个围绕机器智能行为组织起来的研究领域名称。
terms.definition_short_en: Artificial Intelligence is not a single technology, but rather the name of a research field organized around the intelligent behavior of machines.

terms.definition_short: 深度学习是机器学习的一支，特点是用很多层网络自动提取特征。
terms.definition_short_en: Deep learning is a branch of machine learning characterized by its use of multi-layered neural networks to automatically extract features from data.

terms.definition_short: 机器学习让系统通过数据改进表现，而不是只执行固定规则。
terms.definition_short_en: Machine learning enables systems to improve their performance through data rather than simply executing fixed, hard-coded rules.

terms.definition_short: GPT 是生成式预训练 Transformer 路线，能生成文本、代码和多种内容。
terms.definition_short_en: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a family of foundation models capable of generating text, code, and various other types of content.

terms.definition_short: 开源模型是开放给外部下载、运行、研究或改造的模型，但要看权重、代码和许可证具体开放到哪一步。
terms.definition_short_en: An open-source model is one made available for external downloading, running, researching, or modifying, though its true openness depends on the specific availability of its weights, code, and licensing.

terms.definition_short: Voice Mode 是 AI 从打字聊天走向实时语音对话的交互方式。
terms.definition_short_en: Voice Mode is an interaction method that shifts AI from text-based chatting to real-time spoken conversations.

terms.definition_short: 神经网络不是复制大脑，而是借用「很多单元相互连接」这个想法来做计算。
terms.definition_short_en: A neural network does not replicate the human brain; rather, it borrows the concept of interconnected units to perform computations.

terms.definition_short: 超参数是模型训练或生成时预先设定的控制旋钮。
terms.definition_short_en: Hyperparameters are the control knobs preset before model training or generation to guide its behavior.

terms.definition_short: 训练是学本领，推理是上场使用本领。
terms.definition_short_en: Training is how an AI learns its skills; inference is when it actually applies those skills in the real world.

terms.definition_short: Knowledge Cutoff 是模型「记忆世界」停在哪一天的时间边界。
terms.definition_short_en: A Knowledge Cutoff is the specific date when an AI model's internal memory of the world stops.

terms.definition_short: LSTM 是 Transformer 之前处理语音、文本和时间序列的重要模型。
terms.definition_short_en: LSTM was a crucial model for processing speech, text, and time series data before the advent of the Transformer.

terms.definition_short: MoE 让大模型拥有很多专家模块，每次只激活其中一部分，以提高规模和效率。
terms.definition_short_en: MoE allows large models to contain numerous expert modules but activates only a subset for each input, scaling up capacity while maintaining computational efficiency.

terms.definition_short: Model Weights 是模型学到的参数，也是模型能力被保存下来的主要形式。
terms.definition_short_en: Model Weights are the parameters learned by a model, serving as the primary form in which its capabilities are stored.

terms.definition_short: 多模态 AI 能同时理解或生成多种信息形式，而不只处理文字。
terms.definition_short_en: Multimodal AI can simultaneously understand, process, or generate multiple forms of information—such as text, images, and audio—rather than being limited to text alone.

terms.definition_short: 参数是模型内部学到的数值，也是模型能力的主要承载形式。
terms.definition_short_en: Parameters are the internal numerical values learned by a model and serve as the primary carrier of its capabilities.

terms.definition_short: 规模定律说明在一定范围内，更多参数、数据和算力通常能带来可预测的性能提升。
terms.definition_short_en: Scaling laws state that, within a certain range, increasing a model's parameters, training data, and computational power generally leads to predictable improvements in performance.

terms.definition_short: 数据中心是承载 AI 算力的机房和基础设施。
terms.definition_short_en: A data center is the physical facility and infrastructure that houses the computing power required for AI.

terms.definition_short: 推理芯片负责把训练好的模型更快、更省电、更便宜地跑起来。
terms.definition_short_en: An inference chip is hardware designed to run pre-trained models faster, more cost-effectively, and with greater energy efficiency.

terms.term: 基于 AI 反馈的强化学习
terms.term_zh: 基于 AI 反馈的强化学习
terms.definition_short: RLAIF 用 AI 反馈替代或补充人类反馈，帮助模型学习偏好和安全规则。
terms.definition_short_en: RLAIF replaces or supplements human feedback with AI feedback to help models learn preferences and safety rules.
terms.displayName: 基于 AI 反馈的强化学习

terms.definition_short: 他代表了早期 AI 里"用符号和搜索解决问题"的路线。
terms.definition_short_en: He represents the foundational early AI approach of using explicit symbols and search algorithms to solve complex problems.

terms.definition_short: 他代表"用游戏和科学问题推动 AI 突破"的研究路线。
terms.definition_short_en: He represents a research philosophy that leverages games and complex scientific problems to drive breakthroughs in artificial intelligence.

terms.definition_short: 普通学习者会看到他的名字，是因为他站在深度学习突破和大模型安全争论的交叉点上。
terms.definition_short_en: He is a central figure in AI history, standing at the intersection of early deep learning breakthroughs and contemporary debates over foundation model safety.

terms.definition_short: 它把"目标行为"和"反馈控制"连在一起，为控制论和 AI 前史提供了思想入口。
terms.definition_short_en: It links "purposeful behavior" with "feedback control," providing a conceptual foundation for cybernetics and the early prehistory of artificial intelligence.

terms.definition_short: DENDRAL 展示了 AI 可以在窄领域里辅助专业推理。
terms.definition_short_en: DENDRAL was an early expert system that demonstrated how AI could successfully assist with professional reasoning within a narrow, specialized domain.

terms.definition_short: 棋类程序让机器智能第一次有了清楚的试验场。
terms.definition_short_en: Early board game programs provided the first clear, structured testing ground for machine intelligence.

terms.definition_short: ELIZA 是早期聊天机器人历史里的经典节点。
terms.definition_short_en: ELIZA is a classic milestone in the early history of chatbots.
terms.back_en: ELIZA is an early chatbot developed by Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT in 1966. It famously used a psychotherapist-style dialogue to make users feel as though the machine could genuinely communicate.
terms.definition_long_en:
Developed by Joseph Weizenbaum at MIT in 1966, ELIZA is a pioneering computer program. Its most famous script, DOCTOR, simulated a Rogerian psychotherapist by generating responses through pattern matching and substitution of user inputs.
At its technical core, ELIZA relied entirely on matching patterns and rewording what the user typed. It possessed no actual understanding of language, yet by returning prompts like "Why do you say that?", it created a powerful illusion of comprehension. This phenomenon later became known as the "ELIZA effect."
Weizenbaum was shocked to see users treating ELIZA as a real confidant, which led him to warn against the ethical risks of AI in his 1976 book Computer Power and Human Reason. This historical event is crucial: ELIZA exposed how easily humans project understanding, empathy, or intelligence onto a machine's linguistic output.
Studying ELIZA today is not about its technical prowess, but about recognizing a persistent issue in conversational AI: the user experience of "seeming to understand" does not equate to actual system comprehension.
terms.why_it_matters_en: It introduced chatbots, human-computer relationships, and AI ethical dilemmas very early in the history of computing.
terms.memory_hook_en: Remember it as: 1966 + Weizenbaum + MIT + pattern matching + the ELIZA effect.
terms.example_en:
· Developed at MIT in 1966.
· The DOCTOR script simulated conversations with a psychotherapist.
· Weizenbaum later warned of AI ethical risks in his book Computer Power and Human Reason.
examples_en: In 1966, Weizenbaum wrote ELIZA at MIT, using simple pattern-matching rules to reflect user input, which made users feel understood.
Weizenbaum's secretary asked him to leave the room because her conversation with ELIZA was too private—an event that turned him into an AI critic.
A few dozen rules tricked people into thinking they were understood—a dynamic similar to what LLMs do today, just on a vastly smaller scale.

terms.definition_short: Lisp 是早期符号 AI 的关键编程语言。
terms.definition_short_en: Lisp is a pioneering programming language designed in 1958 that served as the foundational tool for early symbolic AI research.

terms.definition_short: 它是符号 AI 早期代表，展示机器可以按逻辑规则寻找证明。
terms.definition_short_en: An early representative of symbolic AI, it demonstrated that machines could search for mathematical proofs by following formal logical rules.

terms.definition_short: 它让 AI 从零散项目变成有机构、有学生、有长期路线的研究中心。
terms.definition_short_en: It transformed AI from scattered projects into an institutionalized research center with students, dedicated funding, and a long-term roadmap.

terms.definition_short: MYCIN 是专家系统进入医疗诊断想象的经典案例。
terms.definition_short_en: MYCIN is a classic early example of an expert system designed to tackle medical diagnosis.

terms.definition_short: 它是神经网络历史里第一次被广泛看见的学习模型之一。
terms.definition_short_en: It is one of the first widely recognized learning models in the history of neural networks.

terms.definition_short: 这本书把感知机的能力边界讲清楚，也影响了后来神经网络研究的走向。
terms.definition_short_en: This book clarified the theoretical boundaries of perceptrons, profoundly influencing the subsequent trajectory of neural network research.

terms.definition_short: Prolog 是符号 AI 和知识表示路线里的重要语言。
terms.definition_short_en: Prolog is a foundational language in the symbolic AI and knowledge representation paradigms.

terms.definition_short: 它展示了机器在封闭小世界里理解语言和执行动作的可能。
terms.definition_short_en: It demonstrated the possibility of a machine understanding language and executing actions within a small, closed world.

terms.definition_short: 它是早期"机器能从经验中改进行为"的直观演示。
terms.definition_short_en: It is an early, tangible demonstration of a machine improving its behavior through experience.

terms.definition_short: SRI 是早期 AI 从实验室想法走向系统工程的重要现场之一。
terms.definition_short_en: SRI was one of the key sites where early AI transitioned from laboratory concepts to applied systems engineering.

terms.definition_short: 它是让 AI 越过聊天框，直接操作图形界面的能力。
terms.definition_short_en: It is the capability that allows AI to step beyond the chat box and directly interact with graphical user interfaces.

terms.definition_short: 它是让 AI Agent 在有限上下文里高效工作的工程方法。
terms.definition_short_en: It is the engineering practice of enabling AI agents to operate efficiently within a limited context window.

terms.definition_short: Human-in-the-loop 是让人参与 AI 决策或执行流程的关键环节。
terms.definition_short_en: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) is a system design that requires human interaction at critical stages of an AI's decision-making or execution process.

terms.definition_short: SWE-bench 是评估 AI Coding Agent 能否处理真实工程任务的标准化测试。
terms.definition_short_en: SWE-bench is a standardized benchmark that evaluates whether AI coding agents can successfully resolve real-world software engineering tasks.

terms.definition_short: NVIDIA 是 AI 算力时代最重要的硬件公司，几乎所有大型 AI 模型的训练都依赖它的 GPU。
terms.definition_short_en: NVIDIA is the most important hardware company in the era of AI computing, with nearly all foundation models relying on its GPUs for training.

terms.term: Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events
terms.term_zh: 分布式系统中的时间时钟与事件排序（1978）
通过反向传播误差来学习表征（1986）

terms.term: The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine
terms.term_zh: 大规模超文本网络搜索引擎的解剖（1998）

terms.definition_short: 美团发布的长猫 2.0 是纯国产算力训练的 1.6 万亿参数 MoE 大模型，100 万上下文，不依赖英伟达。
terms.definition_short_en: Released by Meituan, LongCat-2.0 is a 1.6-trillion-parameter MoE foundation model trained entirely on domestic computing power, featuring a 1-million-token context window and zero reliance on NVIDIA.

terms.definition_short: 寒武纪成立于 2016 年，是中国 AI 芯片龙头企业，以神经网络处理器 NPU 架构闻名。2026 年 6 月 30 日市值突破 1 万亿人民币。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2016, Cambricon is a leading Chinese AI chip company known for its Neural Processing Unit (NPU) architecture. On June 30, 2026, its market capitalization surpassed one trillion RMB.

terms.definition_short: 华为昇腾是国产 AI 芯片中使用最广泛的系列，覆盖云端训练卡到边缘推理卡，支撑了 DeepSeek 等国产大模型的适配。
terms.definition_short_en: Huawei Ascend is the most widely used series of domestic AI chips in China, ranging from cloud training to edge inference, and supports the adaptation of domestic foundation models like DeepSeek.

terms.definition_short: 百度成立于 2000 年，是中国最大的搜索引擎公司。2010 年起全面投入 AI，推出文心大模型、百度 Apollo 自动驾驶、飞桨深度学习平台、昆仑芯片等。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2000, Baidu is China's largest search engine company. It fully committed to AI in 2010, launching the ERNIE foundation models, Apollo autonomous driving platform, PaddlePaddle deep learning framework, and Kunlun chips.

terms.definition_short: 阿里巴巴成立于 1999 年，是中国最大的电商和云计算公司。2017 年成立达摩院（DAMO Academy）聚焦 AI 基础研究，推出通义千问大模型系列。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 1999, Alibaba is China's largest e-commerce and cloud computing company. It established the DAMO Academy in 2017 for fundamental AI research and later launched the Qwen series of foundation models.

terms.definition_short: 腾讯成立于 1998 年，是中国最大的社交和游戏公司。2016 年成立腾讯 AI Lab，2018 年推出混元（Hunyuan）大模型系列。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 1998, Tencent is China's largest social media and gaming company. It established Tencent AI Lab in 2016 and launched the Hunyuan foundation model series in 2018.

terms.definition_short: 字节跳动成立于 2012 年，以今日头条和抖音两大产品闻名。其推荐算法是 AI 在消费级应用中最早的大规模成功案例之一。2023 年推出豆包（Doubao）大模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2012 and known for Toutiao and Douyin (TikTok), ByteDance's recommendation algorithms represent one of the earliest large-scale successes of AI in consumer apps. In 2023, it launched the Doubao foundation model.

terms.definition_short: 华为成立于 1987 年，是全球最大的通信设备商之一。在 AI 领域，华为推出了昇腾（Ascend）AI 芯片系列、MindSpore 深度学习框架、盘古（Pangu）大模型系列，形成了从硬件到软件到应用的完整 AI 栈。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global telecommunications equipment provider. In AI, it has built a complete hardware-to-application stack featuring Ascend AI chips, the MindSpore deep learning framework, and the Pangu foundation model series.

terms.definition_short: 商汤科技成立于 2014 年，由香港中文大学汤晓鸥教授创立，是中国计算机视觉领域的龙头企业。2018 年成为全球估值最高的 AI 独角兽，2021 年在港交所上市。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2014 by Professor Tang Xiao'ou at the Chinese University of Hong Kong, SenseTime is a leading Chinese computer vision company. It became the world's most valuable AI unicorn in 2018 and went public in Hong Kong in 2021.

terms.definition_short: 唐杰是清华大学计算机系教授、智源人工智能研究院理事长。他领导了 GLM 系列大模型、CogView 文生图模型、CogVLM 多模态模型的研发。
terms.definition_short_en: Jie Tang is a computer science professor at Tsinghua University and Chairman of the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI). He led the development of the GLM foundation models, the CogView text-to-image model, and the CogVLM multimodal model.

terms.definition_short: 张潼是美国康奈尔大学博士、机器学习领域的世界级学者。曾任百度研究院副院长、腾讯 AI Lab 创始主任，是中国 AI 产业从学术走向应用的关键人物之一。
terms.definition_short_en: Tong Zhang is a Cornell Ph.D. and world-class machine learning scholar. As the former Deputy Director of Baidu Research and founding director of Tencent AI Lab, he helped transition China's AI industry from academia to practical application.

terms.definition_short: 周志华是南京大学计算机系主任、人工智能学院院长。他在集成学习、多标记学习、降维等方向有系统性贡献，其著作《机器学习》（西瓜书）是国内深度学习入门的第一经典。
terms.definition_short_en: Zhi-Hua Zhou is the Head of the Computer Science Department at Nanjing University. He has made systematic contributions to ensemble learning, and his textbook *Machine Learning* (the "Watermelon Book") is China's premier introductory classic for deep learning beginners.

terms.definition_short: 李沐是亚马逊云科技（AWS）资深首席科学家、上海交通大学教授。他是深度学习框架 MXNet 的核心作者之一，与 Aston Zhang 合著的《动手学深度学习》（d2l.ai）是最受欢迎的深度学习实战教材之一。
terms.definition_short_en: Mu Li is a professor at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and former Senior Principal Scientist at AWS. He is a core contributor to the MXNet framework and co-author of Dive into Deep Learning (d2l.ai), a highly popular practical textbook.

terms.definition_short: 孙剑（1978-2022）是旷视科技首席科学家，曾任微软亚洲研究院研究员。他是深度残差网络（ResNet）的共同作者之一——这篇论文是计算机视觉领域被引用次数最高的论文之一。
terms.definition_short_en: Jian Sun (1978–2022) was the Chief Scientist at Megvii and a former researcher at Microsoft Research Asia. He co-authored the Deep Residual Network (ResNet) paper, one of the most highly cited publications in computer vision history.

terms.definition_short: 百川智能成立于 2023 年 4 月，由王小川创立。Baichuan-7B/13B 是首批高质量开源中文大模型之一，Baichuan2 系列在多个中文基准上表现突出。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in April 2023 by Wang Xiaochuan, Baichuan is known for Baichuan-7B and 13B, which were among the first high-quality open-source Chinese foundation models. Its Baichuan2 series has performed strongly on multiple Chinese benchmarks.

terms.definition_short: 零一万物（01.AI）由李开复于 2023 年创立。Yi-34B 发布时在多个基准上超越同类规模的开源模型，以超长上下文窗口（200K tokens）著称。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded by Kai-Fu Lee in 2023, 01.AI developed the Yi-34B model, which outperformed similarly sized open-source models upon release and is notable for its ultra-long 200K-token context window.

terms.definition_short: 阶跃星辰（StepFun）成立于 2023 年，由前微软亚洲研究院首席科学家姜大昕创立。在视频生成和多模态大模型方向有技术积累，发布 Step 系列视频生成模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2023 by Daxin Jiang, former Chief Scientist at Microsoft Research Asia, StepFun is an AI startup with technical expertise in video generation and multimodal foundation models, known for releasing the Step series of video generation models.

terms.definition_short: MiniCPM 由面壁智能（ModelBest）推出，是一系列轻量级端侧大模型。MiniCPM-2B 以 24 亿参数在多个基准上超越同等甚至更大尺寸的模型，证明了小模型路线的可行性。
terms.definition_short_en: Developed by ModelBest, MiniCPM is a series of lightweight, on-device foundation models. The company reported that its 2.4-billion-parameter MiniCPM-2B model outperforms similar or even larger models across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating the viability of the small model approach.

terms.definition_short: Mira Murati 是 OpenAI 的前 CTO，在 2018-2024 年间主导了 ChatGPT、GPT-4、DALL·E 等产品的工程化和发布流程。2024 年底离职后创办 Thinking Machines，主张针对不同任务训练不同规模的专业模型，反对大一统模型路线。
terms.definition_short_en: Mira Murati is OpenAI's former CTO who led the engineering of ChatGPT, GPT-4, and DALL·E (2018–2024). She later founded Thinking Machines, advocating for specialized models over a single unified model approach.

terms.definition_short: Thinking Machines 由前 OpenAI CTO Mira Murati 于 2025 年创办，是一家开源优先的 AI 研究实验室。它的第一个模型 Inkling 于 2026 年 7 月发布——9750 亿参数，Apache 2.0 许可，权重完全开放。公司路线明确反对大一统模型，主张针对不同任务训练不同规模的专业模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded in 2025 by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati, Thinking Machines is an open-source-first AI lab. It explicitly opposes monolithic architectures, advocating for specialized models. Its first open-weight model, the 975-billion-parameter Inkling, was released in July 2026.

terms.definition_short: Terminal-Bench 是一个评估 AI Agent 在真实终端环境下的规划、执行和调试能力的基准测试。与 MMLU 之类的单选题不同，Terminal-Bench 把模型放进真实的命令行环境，要求它自主完成安装软件、配置环境、调试代码、分析数据等多步任务。它是衡量「AI Agent 能不能真正干活」的新标准。
terms.definition_short_en: Terminal-Bench evaluates AI agents' planning, execution, and debugging skills in real terminal environments. Unlike multiple-choice tests like MMLU, it requires models to autonomously complete multi-step command-line tasks—such as installing software or debugging code—measuring their practical ability to execute work.

terms.definition_short: ChatGPT Work 是 OpenAI 在 2026 年 7 月推出的办公代理产品。与普通 ChatGPT 的单轮对话不同，ChatGPT Work 能自主在终端和浏览器中执行多步任务、调用工具、读写文件、生成完整文档。它内置 Codex 技术，ultra 模式下协调 4 个 agent 并行处理。支持跨 Slack、Notion、Microsoft 365 和 Google Drive 拉取上下文。
terms.definition_short_en: Launched in July 2026, ChatGPT Work is an OpenAI office agent that autonomously executes multi-step tasks, uses tools, and coordinates up to four parallel agents in Ultra mode while pulling context across platforms like Slack and Google Drive.

terms.definition_short: Kimi K3 是月之暗面于 2026 年 7 月发布的旗舰大模型，2.8 万亿参数，MoE 架构（896 专家、激活 16 个），100 万 token 上下文。采用自研 KDA（Kimi Delta Attention）混合线性注意力，百万上下文解码加速 6.3 倍。AttnRes 结构额外成本不到 2%，训练效率提升约 25%。开源权重，计划 7 月 27 日前发布。
terms.definition_short_en: Kimi K3 is Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE flagship model featuring a 1M-token context window. It utilizes proprietary KDA and AttnRes architectures to significantly boost decoding speed and training efficiency. Its open weights are scheduled for release by late July 2026.

terms.definition_short: 月之暗面（Moonshot AI）由清华博士杨植麟于 2023 年创办，是中国最受关注的大模型创业公司。其 Kimi 系列模型以超长上下文能力为差异化特色——2024 年率先达到 200 万字上下文窗口。2026 年 7 月发布的 Kimi K3 以 2.8 万亿参数成为全球最大开源模型，在真实任务基准上系统性逼近美国顶级闭源模型。
terms.definition_short_en: Founded by Yang Zhilin in 2023, Moonshot AI is a leading Chinese startup known for ultra-long context windows. Its July 2026 release, Kimi K3, is a 2.8-trillion-parameter open-weight model that systematically approaches top-tier US closed models on real-world benchmarks.
